a1-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Greetings
a1-01.scenario: You meet a native Spanish speaker at an international meetup.
a1-01.prompt: Say hello, introduce yourself by name, and say where you are from.
a1-01.target: Hola, me llamo Carlos y soy de España.
a1-01.english: Hello, my name is Carlos and I'm from Spain.
a1-01.canDo: I can greet someone and introduce myself.

a1-restaurant.title: Communicative Challenge: Ordering
a1-restaurant.scenario: You are at a café in Madrid.
a1-restaurant.prompt: Ask for a coffee and a bottle of water politely.
cues: Request water (Y una botella de agua)
a1-restaurant.target: Un café y una botella de agua, por favor.
a1-restaurant.english: A coffee and a bottle of water, please.
a1-restaurant.canDo: I can order simple food and drinks.

a2-restaurant.title: Communicative Challenge: Dining Out
a2-restaurant.scenario: You are ordering dinner at a traditional restaurant for your table.
a2-restaurant.prompt: Order for the table: an appetizer, drinks, and a main course, and ask about the bill.
cues: 1. Request table/greeting: 'Buenas noches, una mesa para dos, por favor.'
2. Order drinks & appetizer: 'De primero queremos unas tapas y vino tinto.'
3. Order main: 'De segundo, el pescado del día.'
a2-restaurant.canDo: I can order a complete meal and drinks for a group in a restaurant.

a2-directions.title: Communicative Challenge: Finding Your Way
a2-directions.scenario: You are lost in the city center trying to find the train station.
a2-directions.prompt: Stop someone on the street, apologize for the interruption, ask where the train station is, and ask if it is far on foot.
cues: 2. Ask direction (¿Dónde está la estación de tren?)
a2-directions.canDo: I can ask for and understand simple directions in town.

b1-story.title: Communicative Challenge: Recounting an Event
b1-story.scenario: A friend asks about an unusual experience you had recently.
b1-story.prompt: Describe an unexpected event that happened to you: where you were, what was happening, what suddenly occurred, and how it was resolved.
cues: Set background scene with imperfect tense
Narrate key actions with preterite tense
b1-story.canDo: I can describe past events, unexpected incidents, and personal reactions in connected speech.

b2-movie-review.title: Communicative Challenge: Film Analysis
b2-movie-review.scenario: You are contributing to a discussion group about cinema.
b2-movie-review.prompt: Describe the plot of the last movie or series you saw, analyze the main characters' motivations, and explain why you would or wouldn't recommend it.
b2-movie-review.canDo: I can summarize plots, analyze character motivation, and critique films with reasoned arguments.

a1-01-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Morning Greeting
a1-01-01.scenario: You arrive at the language exchange in the morning and see Carlos at a table. He helps you with your Spanish, and then you need to leave; you will see him again tomorrow.
a1-01-01.prompt: Greet Carlos for the morning, thank him, and say see you tomorrow.
a1-01-01.english: Good morning, Carlos. Thank you. See you tomorrow!
a1-01-01.canDo: I can greet someone in Spanish.

a1-01-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Introducing Yourself
a1-01-02.scenario: Meg sits down at your table at the language exchange and says she is a student. You are Carlos, and you are from Hungary.
a1-01-02.prompt: Say hello to Meg, tell her that you are Carlos, and say where you are from.
a1-01-02.target: Hola, Meg. Soy Carlos. Soy de Hungría.
a1-01-02.english: Hello, Meg. I am Carlos. I am from Hungary.
a1-01-02.canDo: I can say my name in Spanish.

a1-01-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Asking Someone's Name
a1-01-03.scenario: It is the afternoon and you meet someone new at the language exchange. You are Meg and want to introduce yourself and learn the other person's name.
a1-01-03.prompt: Greet the person for the afternoon, say your name is Meg, and ask what their name is.
cues: Greet the person for the afternoon
a1-01-03.target: Buenas tardes. Me llamo Meg. ¿Cómo te llamas?
a1-01-03.english: Good afternoon. My name is Meg. What is your name?
a1-01-03.canDo: I can ask someone their name.

a1-01-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are You From?
a1-01-04.scenario: You are Carlos from Hungary, chatting with Meg at the language exchange. You want to tell her where you are from and ask where she is from.
a1-01-04.prompt: Say that you are Carlos, say you are from Hungary, and ask Meg where she is from.
cues: Say that you are from Hungary
Ask Meg where she is from
a1-01-04.target: Soy Carlos. Soy de Hungría. ¿De dónde eres, Meg?
a1-01-04.english: I am Carlos. I am from Hungary. Where are you from, Meg?
a1-01-04.canDo: I can say where I am from.

a1-01-05.title: Communicative Challenge: First Conversation
a1-01-05.scenario: Meg has just introduced herself to you at the Mexican restaurant in Hanoi. You are Carlos from Hungary and want to introduce yourself warmly and ask where she is from.
a1-01-05.prompt: Say your name is Carlos and that it is nice to meet Meg, say you are from Hungary, and ask where she is from.
cues: Say your name is Carlos and it is nice to meet Meg
Say that you are from Hungary
a1-01-05.target: Me llamo Carlos, mucho gusto, Meg. Soy de Hungría. ¿De dónde eres?
a1-01-05.english: My name is Carlos, nice to meet you, Meg. I am from Hungary. Where are you from?
a1-01-05.canDo: I can have a short first conversation.

a1-01-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Meeting at the Exchange
a1-01-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg at the evening language exchange. A new student sits down at your table and greets you.
a1-01-consolidation.prompt: Greet the student for the evening, say your name is Meg and that you are from South Africa, and ask what their name is.
cues: Greet the student for the evening
Say your name is Meg and that you are from South Africa
a1-01-consolidation.target: Buenas noches. Me llamo Meg y soy de Sudáfrica. ¿Cómo te llamas?
a1-01-consolidation.english: Good evening. My name is Meg and I am from South Africa. What is your name?
a1-01-consolidation.canDo: I can greet someone and respond appropriately.

a1-02-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Respond to an Introduction
a1-02-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Meg has just introduced you, Carlos, to her classmate. The classmate is waiting for you to say hello and say your name.
a1-02-01.prompt: Say hello, say your name is Carlos, and say you are pleased to meet her.
cues: Say you are pleased to meet her
a1-02-01.english: Hello. My name is Carlos. Pleased to meet you.
a1-02-01.canDo: I can respond when someone introduces themselves.

a1-02-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Say Who Someone Is
a1-02-02.scenario: You are Meg at the language exchange in Hanoi. Carlos points at the woman at the next table and asks who she is. She is Daniela, a classmate of yours.
a1-02-02.prompt: Tell Carlos who the woman is and that she is your classmate.
a1-02-02.target: Ella es Daniela. Ella es mi compañera.
a1-02-02.english: She is Daniela. She is my classmate.
a1-02-02.canDo: I can say who a person is.

a1-02-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Ask Why
a1-02-03.scenario: You are Carlos at the language exchange in Hanoi. You are new there because you are a student, and you are chatting with Meg about her Spanish.
a1-02-03.prompt: Tell Meg you are new here because you are a student, and ask her why she studies Spanish.
cues: Say you are new here and give your reason
Ask Meg why she studies Spanish
a1-02-03.target: Soy nuevo aquí porque soy estudiante. ¿Por qué estudias español, Meg?
a1-02-03.english: I am new here because I am a student. Why do you study Spanish, Meg?
a1-02-03.canDo: I can ask a simple question with por qué.

a1-02-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Introduce Another Person
a1-02-04.scenario: You are Meg at the language exchange in Hanoi. Carlos has just sat down at your table, and your friend Daniela from class is next to you.
a1-02-04.prompt: Introduce Daniela to Carlos, say she is your friend, and say she is also your classmate.
cues: Say she is also your classmate
a1-02-04.target: Carlos, te presento a Daniela. Ella es mi amiga y también mi compañera.
a1-02-04.english: Carlos, let me introduce Daniela to you. She is my friend and also my classmate.

a1-02-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A First Conversation
a1-02-05.scenario: You are Meg at the language exchange in Hanoi. Your friend Daniela has joined the group, and Carlos is sitting between you. You want them to meet, and you are curious about Carlos.
a1-02-05.prompt: Introduce Carlos to Daniela as your friend, then ask Carlos why he studies Spanish.
cues: Introduce Carlos to Daniela as your friend
Ask Carlos why he studies Spanish
a1-02-05.target: Daniela, él es mi amigo Carlos. Carlos, ¿por qué estudias español?
a1-02-05.english: Daniela, he is my friend Carlos. Carlos, why do you study Spanish?
a1-02-05.canDo: I can introduce someone in a short conversation.

a1-02-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Meet Meg's Friend
a1-02-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos at the language exchange in Hanoi. Meg has just introduced you to her friend Daniela, who is waiting for your reply.
a1-02-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela you are pleased to meet her, say your name is Carlos, and say that Meg is your friend.
cues: Say you are pleased to meet Daniela
a1-02-consolidation.target: Mucho gusto, Daniela. Me llamo Carlos. Meg es mi amiga.
a1-02-consolidation.english: Nice to meet you, Daniela. My name is Carlos. Meg is my friend.
a1-02-consolidation.canDo: I can respond to an introduction and say who a friend is.

a1-03-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Name Two Things
a1-03-01.scenario: You are Meg at the study table in the library in Hanoi. Carlos holds up a book and then a photo, and asks you what each one is.
a1-03-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that one thing is a book and the other is a photo.
cues: Say what the first thing is
Say what the second thing is
a1-03-01.target: Es un libro. Es una foto.
a1-03-01.english: It is a book. It is a photo.
a1-03-01.canDo: I can name a person or thing with an indefinite article.

a1-03-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Boy or Girl
a1-03-02.scenario: You are Carlos at the study table in the library in Hanoi. Meg is looking at the photo of your family in Hungary and asks what the two people in the front are, a boy and a girl.
a1-03-02.prompt: Tell Meg that one person in the photo is a boy and the other is a girl.
cues: Say that one person is a boy
Say that the other is a girl
a1-03-02.target: Es un chico. Es una chica.
a1-03-02.english: He is a boy. She is a girl.
a1-03-02.canDo: I can recognise basic masculine and feminine nouns.

a1-03-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is It?
a1-03-03.scenario: You are Carlos at the study table in the library in Hanoi. Meg asks you where the phone and the photos are, and you can see both.
a1-03-03.prompt: Tell Meg where the phone is and where the photos are.
a1-03-03.target: El teléfono está aquí. Las fotos están aquí.
a1-03-03.english: The phone is here. The photos are here.
a1-03-03.canDo: I can use el, la, los and las with familiar nouns.

a1-03-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Describe a Brother and a Sister
a1-03-04.scenario: You are Carlos at the study table in the library in Hanoi. Meg is looking at the photo of your family in Hungary and asks what your brother and your sister are like.
a1-03-04.prompt: Tell Meg that your brother is tall and your sister is friendly.
cues: Say what the brother is like
Say what the sister is like
a1-03-04.target: Él es alto. Ella es simpática.
a1-03-04.english: He is tall. She is friendly.
a1-03-04.canDo: I can describe a person with a simple adjective.

a1-03-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Carlos?
a1-03-05.scenario: You are Meg at the study table in the library in Hanoi. Your friend Daniela comes over and asks you who Carlos is, the boy sitting beside you.
a1-03-05.prompt: Tell Daniela that he is a tall boy and that he is friendly.
cues: Say who he is and that he is tall
a1-03-05.target: Es un chico alto. Es simpático.
a1-03-05.english: He is a tall boy. He is friendly.
a1-03-05.canDo: I can identify a person with an article and an adjective.

a1-03-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Things on the Table
a1-03-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg at the study table in the library in Hanoi. Carlos points at a phone, some photos and a book, and asks what they are.
a1-03-consolidation.prompt: Say that one thing is a phone, say that the others are some photos, and say that the book is small.
cues: Say what the first thing is
Say what the book is like
a1-03-consolidation.target: Es un teléfono. Son unas fotos. El libro es pequeño.
a1-03-consolidation.english: It is a phone. They are some photos. The book is small.
a1-03-consolidation.canDo: I can choose the right article for a noun.

a1-03c-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is Carlos Like?
a1-03c-01.scenario: You are at the language exchange in Hanoi. Meg sits down next to you and asks what your friend Carlos is like. You know him well.
a1-03c-01.prompt: Tell Meg that Carlos is tall and friendly.
cues: Say who you are talking about
a1-03c-01.canDo: I can describe someone's appearance or personality.

a1-03c-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Meg's Sisters
a1-03c-02.scenario: Carlos is looking at photos of Meg's family at the language exchange. He asks you about Meg's two sisters, and you know them both: one is funny, the other is shy.
a1-03c-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that Lauren is funny and that Kaylee is shy.
a1-03c-02.target: Lauren es divertida. Kaylee es tímida.
a1-03c-02.english: Lauren is funny. Kaylee is shy.
a1-03c-02.canDo: I can recognise masculine and feminine adjective forms.

a1-03c-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Friends
a1-03c-03.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Meg asks you about two people in your class, Carlos and Daniela. You think they are both tall and friendly.
a1-03c-03.prompt: Tell Meg that Carlos and Daniela are tall and friendly.
a1-03c-03.target: Carlos y Daniela son altos y simpáticos.
a1-03c-03.english: Carlos and Daniela are tall and friendly.
a1-03c-03.canDo: I can describe more than one person.

a1-03c-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Daniela?
a1-03c-04.scenario: A new student joins the group at the language exchange. Carlos points at Daniela and asks you who she is. She is a friendly woman and a teacher in your class.
a1-03c-04.prompt: Tell Carlos that Daniela is a friendly woman.
a1-03c-04.canDo: I can identify a person with a simple noun phrase.

a1-03c-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is the Teacher?
a1-03c-05.scenario: You and Carlos are looking at a group photo from your class. Carlos asks who the man next to Daniela is. He is older and serious, and he is a teacher.
a1-03c-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that the man is older and serious, and that he is a teacher.
cues: Say he is older and serious
a1-03c-05.target: Es un hombre mayor y serio. Es profesor.
a1-03c-05.english: He is an older, serious man. He is a teacher.
a1-03c-05.canDo: I can describe a person with two or more adjectives.

a1-03c-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Introducing Carlos
a1-03c-consolidation.scenario: At the language exchange, Meg introduces you to her friend Daniela. Daniela has not met Carlos yet and asks who he is. You tell her about him: where he is from and what he is like.
a1-03c-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela that Carlos is a tall man and that he is from Hungary.
a1-03c-consolidation.target: Carlos es un hombre alto. Es de Hungría.
a1-03c-consolidation.english: Carlos is a tall man. He is from Hungary.
a1-03c-consolidation.canDo: I can use un and una with words for people.

a1-05-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Brothers and Sisters
a1-05-01.scenario: You are chatting with Carlos at the language exchange in Hanoi. He asks whether you have brothers or sisters. You have one brother and one sister.
a1-05-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have a brother and a sister.
cues: Say you also have a sister
a1-05-01.target: Tengo un hermano y una hermana.
a1-05-01.english: I have a brother and a sister.
a1-05-01.canDo: I can use tener to say which family members you have.

a1-05-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Family Photo
a1-05-02.scenario: At the language exchange, Meg sees a photo on your phone of an older man and woman and asks who they are. They are your grandparents.
a1-05-02.prompt: Tell Meg that they are your grandparents.
a1-05-02.canDo: I can use mi, tu and su with singular and plural family nouns.

a1-05-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Cousins
a1-05-03.scenario: Carlos asks you about your cousins while you wait for the language exchange to start. You have two cousins, and your male cousin is very kind.
a1-05-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have two cousins and that your male cousin is kind.
cues: Say how many cousins you have
Say your male cousin is kind
a1-05-03.target: Tengo dos primos. Mi primo es amable.
a1-05-03.english: I have two cousins. My cousin is kind.
a1-05-03.canDo: I can talk about family relationships using tener and possessives.

a1-05-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Parents
a1-05-04.scenario: Meg asks you what your parents are like while you have coffee after the language exchange. Your mother is calm and your father is kind.
a1-05-04.prompt: Tell Meg that your mother is calm and your father is kind.
a1-05-04.target: Mi madre es tranquila. Mi padre es amable.
a1-05-04.english: My mother is calm. My father is kind.
a1-05-04.canDo: I can describe family members with ser and simple adjectives.

a1-05-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Introducing My Sister
a1-05-05.scenario: You show Carlos a family photo on your phone at the language exchange. He asks who the girl next to you is. She is your sister, and she is funny.
a1-05-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that she is your sister and that she is funny.
a1-05-05.target: Ella es mi hermana. Es divertida.
a1-05-05.english: She is my sister. She is funny.
a1-05-05.canDo: I can introduce family members and give simple descriptions.

a1-05-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Family
a1-05-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks about your family at the language exchange. You have a sister, and your mother is kind.
a1-05-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that you have a sister and that your mother is kind.
a1-05-consolidation.target: Tengo una hermana. Mi madre es amable.
a1-05-consolidation.english: I have a sister. My mother is kind.
a1-05-consolidation.canDo: I can retrieve family vocabulary and grammar.

a1-12-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Your age
a1-12-01.scenario: You are at the language exchange in Hanoi. Carlos asks how old you are. You are twenty.
a1-12-01.prompt: Tell Carlos how old you are.
cues: Say it as an age, with the word for years
a1-12-01.canDo: Recognise and use Spanish numbers from 1 to 20.

a1-12-02.title: Communicative Challenge: How old is she?
a1-12-02.scenario: You are talking with Meg at the language exchange in Hanoi. She asks how old your grandmother is. She is seventy-five.
a1-12-02.prompt: Tell Meg how old your grandmother is.
cues: Say that she is seventy-five years old
a1-12-02.target: Mi abuela tiene setenta y cinco años.
a1-12-02.english: My grandmother is seventy-five years old.
a1-12-02.canDo: Recognise and use numbers from 21 to 100.

a1-12-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What time is it?
a1-12-03.scenario: You are waiting outside the language school in Hanoi with Carlos. He asks you what time it is. It is half past four.

a1-12-04.title: Communicative Challenge: When is the class?
a1-12-04.scenario: Carlos has invited you to his Spanish class in Hanoi. You want to know when it starts.
a1-12-04.prompt: Ask Carlos what time the class is.
a1-12-04.canDo: Ask when and at what time something is.

a1-12-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Your evening
a1-12-05.scenario: Meg asks about your evening in Hanoi. You have class at six and dinner is at seven.
cues: Say you have class and when
a1-12-05.target: Tengo clase a las seis. La cena es a las siete.
a1-12-05.english: I have class at six. Dinner is at seven.
a1-12-05.canDo: Talk about a simple daily schedule.

a1-12-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My brother's day
a1-12-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks you about your younger brother in Hanoi: how old he is and what time his class is. He is twelve and his class is at eight.
a1-12-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg his age and when his class is.
cues: Say how old your brother is
Say what time he has class
a1-12-consolidation.target: Mi hermano tiene doce años. Tiene clase a las ocho.
a1-12-consolidation.english: My brother is twelve years old. He has class at eight.
a1-12-consolidation.canDo: I can use numbers, tell the time and talk about schedules.

a1-06-01.title: Communicative Challenge: My Day
a1-06-01.scenario: Carlos asks what you do on a normal day at the language exchange in Hanoi. You work in the morning and study Spanish in the afternoon.
a1-06-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that you work in the morning and study Spanish in the afternoon.
cues: Say what you do in the morning
Say what you do in the afternoon
a1-06-01.target: Trabajo por la mañana. Estudio español por la tarde.
a1-06-01.english: I work in the morning. I study Spanish in the afternoon.
a1-06-01.canDo: Say what I do using simple regular present-tense forms.

a1-06-02.title: Communicative Challenge: After Class
a1-06-02.scenario: Meg asks what you and Carlos do at home after class. You cook at home, and Carlos listens to music.
a1-06-02.prompt: Tell Meg that you cook at home and that Carlos listens to music.
cues: Say what you do at home
a1-06-02.target: Cocino en casa. Carlos escucha música.
a1-06-02.english: I cook at home. Carlos listens to music.
a1-06-02.canDo: Use regular -ar verbs in the present tense.

a1-06-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Where I Live
a1-06-03.scenario: Daniela asks you where you live and what you drink in the morning. You live in Hanoi and you drink coffee.
a1-06-03.prompt: Tell Daniela where you live and what you drink in the morning.
cues: Say what you drink in the morning
a1-06-03.target: Vivo en Hanoi. Bebo café por la mañana.
a1-06-03.english: I live in Hanoi. I drink coffee in the morning.
a1-06-03.canDo: Use regular -er and -ir verbs in the present tense.

a1-06-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting Ready
a1-06-04.scenario: Meg asks you about your morning before the Spanish class in Hanoi. You get up early and you take a shower.
a1-06-04.prompt: Tell Meg that you get up early and that you take a shower in the morning.
cues: Say you take a shower in the morning
a1-06-04.target: Me levanto temprano. Me ducho por la mañana.
a1-06-04.english: I get up early. I take a shower in the morning.
a1-06-04.canDo: Talk about my daily routine using reflexive verbs.

a1-06-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Full Day
a1-06-05.scenario: On Wednesday evening Carlos calls you on video and asks about your day. You get up and have breakfast, then you work, and after dinner you take a shower.
a1-06-05.prompt: Tell Carlos about your day: what you do first, then what you do next, and what you do after dinner.
cues: Say you get up and have breakfast
Say what you do after dinner
a1-06-05.target: Me levanto y desayuno. Luego trabajo. Después de cenar me ducho.
a1-06-05.english: I get up and have breakfast. Then I work. After dinner I take a shower.
a1-06-05.canDo: Describe a full day with regular and reflexive verbs.

a1-06-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Sister and My Day
a1-06-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks whether you have brothers or sisters. You have one sister, she is kind, and she works in the morning.
a1-06-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that you have a sister, that she is kind and that she works in the morning.
a1-06-consolidation.target: Tengo una hermana. Mi hermana es amable y trabaja por la mañana.
a1-06-consolidation.english: I have a sister. My sister is kind and she works in the morning.
a1-06-consolidation.canDo: I can use regular present tense, ser, and tener with earlier A1 vocabulary.

a1-reflexive-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Morning Wash
a1-reflexive-01.scenario: Meg asks about your morning before the Spanish class in Hanoi. You get up early, and you wash your face and brush your teeth.
a1-reflexive-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you get up early and that you wash your face and brush your teeth.
cues: Say you wash your face and your teeth
a1-reflexive-01.target: Me levanto temprano y me lavo la cara y los dientes.
a1-reflexive-01.english: I get up early and I wash my face and brush my teeth.
a1-reflexive-01.canDo: Use reflexive pronouns to talk about getting up, showering and washing.

a1-reflexive-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Early and Late
a1-reflexive-02.scenario: Carlos asks when you wake up and when you go to bed. You wake up early and you go to bed late.
a1-reflexive-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you wake up early and that you go to bed late.
cues: Say you go to bed late
a1-reflexive-02.target: Me despierto temprano y me acuesto tarde.
a1-reflexive-02.english: I wake up early and I go to bed late.
a1-reflexive-02.canDo: I can conjugate despertarse and acostarse with the correct vowel changes.

a1-reflexive-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Put On
a1-reflexive-03.scenario: Daniela asks what you do after you wake up on a school day. You get dressed and you put on a shirt and trousers.
a1-reflexive-03.prompt: Tell Daniela that you get dressed and that you put on a shirt and trousers.
a1-reflexive-03.target: Me visto y me pongo la camisa y los pantalones.
a1-reflexive-03.english: I get dressed and I put on the shirt and the trousers.
a1-reflexive-03.canDo: I can describe what I put on and wear each morning.

a1-reflexive-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Dishes and Hands
a1-reflexive-04.scenario: Carlos asks what you do after dinner. You wash the dishes and then you wash your hands.
a1-reflexive-04.prompt: Tell Carlos that you wash the dishes and that you wash your hands.
a1-reflexive-04.target: Lavo los platos y me lavo las manos.
a1-reflexive-04.english: I wash the dishes and I wash my hands.
a1-reflexive-04.canDo: Tell actions done to myself (me lavo) from actions done to something else (lavo).

a1-reflexive-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Evening in Order
a1-reflexive-05.scenario: Meg asks you to tell your evening in order. You have dinner, then you brush your teeth, and before going to bed you read a book.
a1-reflexive-05.prompt: Tell Meg your evening in order: first dinner, then your teeth, and what you do before going to bed.
cues: Say what you do before going to bed
a1-reflexive-05.target: Primero ceno. Luego me lavo los dientes y, antes de acostarme, leo un libro.
a1-reflexive-05.english: First I have dinner. Then I brush my teeth and, before going to bed, I read a book.
a1-reflexive-05.canDo: I can narrate my full day step-by-step using sequence connectors.

a1-reflexive-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Mornings with My Sister
a1-reflexive-consolidation.scenario: Daniela asks about your mornings. You wake up early, and you and your sister take a shower in the morning.
a1-reflexive-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela that you wake up early and that you and your sister take a shower in the morning.
cues: Say you and your sister shower in the morning
a1-reflexive-consolidation.target: Me despierto temprano. Mi hermana y yo nos duchamos por la mañana.
a1-reflexive-consolidation.english: I wake up early. My sister and I take a shower in the morning.
a1-reflexive-consolidation.canDo: I can conjugate reflexive verbs correctly with all pronouns (me, te, se, nos, se).

a1-07-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Rooms in My Home
a1-07-01.scenario: Meg asks what rooms there are in your home. There is a kitchen, a bathroom and a garden.
a1-07-01.prompt: Tell Meg which rooms there are in your home: a kitchen, a bathroom and a garden.
a1-07-01.target: Hay una cocina, un baño y un jardín.
a1-07-01.english: There is a kitchen, a bathroom and a garden.
a1-07-01.canDo: Identify and name the main rooms in a home.

a1-07-02.title: Communicative Challenge: In the Living Room
a1-07-02.scenario: Daniela asks what there is in your living room. There is a sofa and there are some chairs.
a1-07-02.prompt: Tell Daniela that there is a sofa and some chairs in your living room.
a1-07-02.target: Hay un sofá y unas sillas en el salón.
a1-07-02.english: There is a sofa and there are some chairs in the living room.
a1-07-02.canDo: Name common things found in a home.

a1-07-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are They?
a1-07-03.scenario: Carlos asks you where the table and the books are in your home. The table is in the kitchen and the books are in the bedroom.
a1-07-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that the table is in the kitchen and that the books are in the bedroom.
a1-07-03.target: La mesa está en la cocina y los libros están en la habitación.
a1-07-03.english: The table is in the kitchen and the books are in the bedroom.
a1-07-03.canDo: Say where specific things are using estar.

a1-07-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Television
a1-07-04.scenario: Meg asks about your living room. There is a television, and it is next to the window.
a1-07-04.prompt: Tell Meg that there is a television in your living room and say where it is.
cues: Say it is next to the window
a1-07-04.target: Hay una televisión en el salón. La televisión está al lado de la ventana.
a1-07-04.english: There is a television in the living room. The television is next to the window.
a1-07-04.canDo: Distinguish between introducing things with hay and locating them with estar.

a1-07-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Showing My Flat
a1-07-05.scenario: Daniela visits your new flat and you show her around. There is a kitchen here, and the bathroom is downstairs.
a1-07-05.prompt: Show Daniela around: say there is a kitchen here and say where the bathroom is.
cues: Say there is a kitchen here
a1-07-05.target: Aquí hay una cocina. El baño está abajo.
a1-07-05.english: There is a kitchen here. The bathroom is downstairs.
a1-07-05.canDo: Introduce rooms and objects in a home.

a1-07-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Home
a1-07-consolidation.scenario: Carlos asks you about your home. It has three rooms and a garden, and the sofa is in the living room.
a1-07-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that your home has three rooms and a garden and say where the sofa is.
cues: Say how many rooms there are
a1-07-consolidation.target: En mi casa hay tres habitaciones y un jardín. El sofá está en el salón.
a1-07-consolidation.english: In my house there are three rooms and a garden. The sofa is in the living room.
a1-07-consolidation.canDo: I can use hay, estar, and articles to describe a home.

a1-08-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Bread and an Apple
a1-08-01.scenario: You are in a supermarket in Hanoi with Meg. She is looking at the shelves and asks what you want to put in the trolley. You want a loaf of bread and an apple.
a1-08-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you want a loaf of bread and an apple.
cues: Say you want a loaf of bread
a1-08-01.target: Quiero un pan y una manzana.
a1-08-01.english: I want a loaf of bread and an apple.
a1-08-01.canDo: Name common foods and shopping items.

a1-08-02.title: Communicative Challenge: How Many Bottles?
a1-08-02.scenario: You are in a supermarket in Hanoi with Carlos, and the water is on the shelf in front of you. You ask him how many bottles of water there are, then say you want two.
a1-08-02.prompt: Ask Carlos how many bottles there are, then say you want two.
cues: Ask how many bottles there are
a1-08-02.english: How many bottles are there? I want two.
a1-08-02.canDo: Ask and answer about simple quantities.

a1-08-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Do You Want?
a1-08-03.scenario: You are at the fruit and milk shelves of a supermarket in Hanoi. Carlos asks what you and Meg want. You want two apples and Meg wants milk.
a1-08-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what you want and what Meg wants.
a1-08-03.target: Quiero dos manzanas. Meg quiere leche.
a1-08-03.english: I want two apples. Meg wants milk.
a1-08-03.canDo: Say what you want in a simple shopping context.

a1-08-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Shopping List
a1-08-04.scenario: You are checking the shopping list in a supermarket in Hanoi. Carlos asks what you need for dinner. You need a kilo of rice and a bottle of water.
a1-08-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what you need for dinner.
cues: Say you need a kilo of rice
a1-08-04.target: Necesito un kilo de arroz y una botella de agua.
a1-08-04.english: I need a kilo of rice and a bottle of water.
a1-08-04.canDo: Say what you need in a simple shopping context.

a1-08-05.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Checkout
a1-08-05.scenario: You and Meg have filled the trolley in a supermarket in Hanoi. Before you walk to the checkout, Meg asks you what you are buying. You want two apples and a kilo of rice, and you pay at the checkout.
a1-08-05.prompt: Tell Meg what you want and that you pay at the checkout.
cues: Say you pay at the checkout
a1-08-05.target: Quiero dos manzanas y un kilo de arroz. Pago en la caja.
a1-08-05.english: I want two apples and a kilo of rice. I pay at the checkout.
a1-08-05.canDo: Make simple shopping requests using food, quantities and verbs.

a1-08-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Shopping with Carlos
a1-08-consolidation.scenario: You are in a supermarket in Hanoi and Carlos is reading out the shopping list. You need a bottle of water and you want three tomatoes.
a1-08-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what you need and what you want.
cues: Say you need a bottle of water
a1-08-consolidation.target: Necesito una botella de agua y quiero tres tomates.
a1-08-consolidation.english: I need a bottle of water and I want three tomatoes.
a1-08-consolidation.canDo: I can use shopping vocabulary, quantities, querer, and necesitar.

a1-demonstrative-01.title: Communicative Challenge: This Book and These Apples
a1-demonstrative-01.scenario: You are at a market stall in Hanoi with Carlos. A book and some apples are right next to you. Carlos asks what you want.
a1-demonstrative-01.prompt: Tell Carlos you want this book and these apples.
cues: Say you want the book next to you
Add the apples next to you
a1-demonstrative-01.target: Quiero este libro y estas manzanas.
a1-demonstrative-01.english: I want this book and these apples.
a1-demonstrative-01.canDo: I can point at items right next to me using este, esta, estos, and estas.

a1-demonstrative-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Bag Is That?
a1-demonstrative-02.scenario: You are at a market stall in Hanoi with Meg. She is holding a bag that is next to her, not next to you. You want to know whose it is, and you like it.
a1-demonstrative-02.prompt: Ask Meg whose bag it is, then say it is very pretty.
a1-demonstrative-02.target: ¿De quién es esa bolsa? Es muy bonita.
a1-demonstrative-02.english: Whose bag is that? It is very pretty.
a1-demonstrative-02.canDo: I can point out objects near the other person using ese, esa, esos, and esas.

a1-demonstrative-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Tower Over There
a1-demonstrative-03.scenario: You and Carlos are walking near a bridge in Hanoi. A tall tower stands far away, near neither of you. Carlos asks what you are looking at.
a1-demonstrative-03.prompt: Tell Carlos which building you are looking at and that it is very tall.
cues: Point out the tower far away
a1-demonstrative-03.english: That tower over there is very tall.
a1-demonstrative-03.canDo: I can use aquel to point out things far away from both of us.

a1-demonstrative-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is This?
a1-demonstrative-04.scenario: At a market stall in Hanoi, Carlos hands you a small object you do not know. You ask what it is. Carlos tells you it is a key.
a1-demonstrative-04.prompt: Ask Carlos what it is, then say it is very interesting.
a1-demonstrative-04.target: ¿Qué es esto? Eso es muy interesante.
a1-demonstrative-04.english: What is this? That is very interesting.
a1-demonstrative-04.canDo: I can ask what unknown things are using ¿Qué es esto? and ¿Qué es eso?

a1-demonstrative-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Choosing a Bag
a1-demonstrative-05.scenario: At a silk stall in Hanoi, Meg asks which of two bags you prefer. One is in your hand, the other is on the shelf by the seller. You choose the one in your hand and buy it.
a1-demonstrative-05.prompt: Tell Meg which bag you prefer and that you will take it.
a1-demonstrative-05.target: Prefiero esta. Me llevo esta bolsa.
a1-demonstrative-05.english: I prefer this one. I will take this bag.
a1-demonstrative-05.canDo: I can choose and buy items at a market using demonstrative pronouns.

a1-demonstrative-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Pointing Things Out
a1-demonstrative-consolidation.scenario: At a market in Hanoi, Meg asks what you need. You need the trousers in your hands and a bag on a shelf far across the stall.
a1-demonstrative-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that you need the trousers and the bag.
cues: Say you need the trousers in your hands
a1-demonstrative-consolidation.target: Necesito estos pantalones y aquella bolsa.
a1-demonstrative-consolidation.english: I need these trousers and that bag over there.
a1-demonstrative-consolidation.canDo: I can use este, ese, and aquel with masculine, feminine, singular, and plural nouns.

a1-cafe-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Drinks at the Café
a1-cafe-01.scenario: You are at a café near the lake in Hanoi with Carlos and Meg. Carlos asks what you and Meg are having to drink. You have a coffee and Meg has a tea.
a1-cafe-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what you drink and what Meg drinks.
a1-cafe-01.english: I drink coffee. Meg drinks tea.
a1-cafe-01.canDo: Name common drinks in a café.

a1-cafe-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Are You Eating?
a1-cafe-02.scenario: You are at a café in Hanoi with Meg and Carlos after Spanish class. Meg asks what you and Carlos are eating. You have a sandwich and Carlos has a cake.
a1-cafe-02.prompt: Tell Meg what you eat and what Carlos eats.
a1-cafe-02.target: Como un sándwich. Carlos come pastel.
a1-cafe-02.english: I eat a sandwich. Carlos eats cake.
a1-cafe-02.canDo: Name common foods in a café.

a1-cafe-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Would You Like?
a1-cafe-03.scenario: You, Carlos and Meg sit down at a café in Hanoi. The waiter asks what you would like. You want a coffee, and Meg wants a tea.
a1-cafe-03.prompt: Tell the waiter what you want and what Meg wants.
cues: Say you want a coffee, politely
a1-cafe-03.target: Quiero un café, por favor. Meg quiere un té.
a1-cafe-03.english: I would like a coffee, please. Meg would like a tea.
a1-cafe-03.canDo: Say what I would like to order.

a1-cafe-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Simple Order
a1-cafe-04.scenario: You are at a café in Hanoi with Carlos. The waiter asks what you would like, and later asks if you want anything else. You want a coffee and a sandwich and nothing more.
a1-cafe-04.prompt: Order a coffee and a sandwich politely, then say that is all.
cues: Order a coffee and a sandwich
a1-cafe-04.target: Quiero un café y un sándwich, por favor. Eso es todo.
a1-cafe-04.english: I would like a coffee and a sandwich, please. That is all.

a1-cafe-05.title: Communicative Challenge: From Hello to the Bill
a1-cafe-05.scenario: After Spanish class you and Meg sit down at a café near the lake in Hanoi. The waiter arrives at your table.
a1-cafe-05.prompt: Greet the waiter, order a tea and a salad, then ask for the bill.
cues: Order a tea and a salad
a1-cafe-05.target: Buenas tardes. Quiero un té y una ensalada, por favor. La cuenta, por favor.
a1-cafe-05.english: Good afternoon. I would like a tea and a salad, please. The bill, please.
a1-cafe-05.canDo: Complete a simple café interaction from greeting to closing.

a1-cafe-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Café Routine
a1-cafe-consolidation.scenario: You are at a café in Hanoi with Carlos. He asks what you usually have there and what you want now. You usually drink coffee and eat a sandwich, and now you want a tea.
a1-cafe-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what you drink and eat there and what you want now.
cues: Say you want a tea now
a1-cafe-consolidation.target: Tomo café y como un sándwich. Ahora quiero un té.
a1-cafe-consolidation.english: I drink coffee and eat a sandwich. Now I want a tea.
a1-cafe-consolidation.canDo: I can use querer, tomar, comer, and café vocabulary.

a1-10-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Party Preparations
a1-10-01.scenario: You are helping Carlos get ready for Meg's surprise birthday party at his flat in Hanoi. He asks what you are doing.
a1-10-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that you are decorating the living room with balloons, and that there is also a cake and candles.
cues: Say you decorate the living room
Say what you decorate it with
Say there is also a cake and candles
a1-10-01.target: Decoro el salón con globos. También hay un pastel y velas.
a1-10-01.english: I decorate the living room with balloons. There is also a cake, and candles.
a1-10-01.canDo: I can name common birthday party items.

a1-10-02.title: Communicative Challenge: How Old Are You?
a1-10-02.scenario: Before Meg's birthday party in Hanoi you are chatting with her. You want to know how old she is turning, and you are thirty yourself.
a1-10-02.prompt: Ask Meg how old she is, then tell her your own age.
a1-10-02.target: ¿Cuántos años tienes, Meg? Yo tengo treinta años.
a1-10-02.english: How old are you, Meg? I'm thirty.
a1-10-02.canDo: I can ask someone's age using ¿Cuántos años tienes?

a1-10-03.title: Communicative Challenge: My Birthday
a1-10-03.scenario: Carlos is writing everyone's birthday on a calendar for Meg's party and asks you when yours is. It is on the eighth of August.
a1-10-03.prompt: Tell Carlos when your birthday is: the eighth of August.
cues: Give the day and the month
a1-10-03.target: Mi cumpleaños es el ocho de agosto.
a1-10-03.english: My birthday is on the eighth of August.
a1-10-03.canDo: I can name the months of the year.

a1-10-04.title: Communicative Challenge: About Me
a1-10-04.scenario: At Meg's birthday party, Daniela wants to get to know you. You are thirty and your birthday is on the third of April.
a1-10-04.prompt: Tell Daniela how old you are and when your birthday is.
cues: Say your birthday date, joined to your age
a1-10-04.target: Tengo treinta años y mi cumpleaños es el tres de abril.
a1-10-04.english: I'm thirty and my birthday is on the third of April.
a1-10-04.canDo: I can combine statements about age and date in one exchange.

a1-10-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Can You Dance?
a1-10-05.scenario: At Meg's surprise party in Carlos's flat there is music, and Daniela asks if you can dance. You can dance, but you can't cook.
a1-10-05.prompt: Tell Daniela that you know how to dance but not how to cook.
cues: Say you know how to dance
Say that you don't know how to cook
a1-10-05.target: Sí, sé bailar, pero no sé cocinar.
a1-10-05.english: Yes, I know how to dance, but I don't know how to cook.
a1-10-05.canDo: I can read and understand a short story about a birthday celebration.

a1-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Party
a1-10-consolidation.scenario: It is the day before Meg's birthday. Daniela asks what you and Carlos will do at the flat. You decorate the living room with balloons and you sing.
a1-10-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela what you and Carlos do at the party.
cues: Say what you decorate and with what
a1-10-consolidation.target: Decoramos el salón con globos y cantamos 'Feliz cumpleaños'.
a1-10-consolidation.english: We decorate the living room with balloons and we sing 'Happy Birthday'.
a1-10-consolidation.canDo: I can review party vocabulary and the verbs decorate, sing, and write.

a1-kitchen-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is in the Kitchen?
a1-kitchen-01.scenario: Meg is coming to cook at Carlos's flat in Hanoi and asks you what there is in his kitchen. There is an oven and a frying pan.
a1-kitchen-01.prompt: Tell Meg that there is an oven and a frying pan in the kitchen.
cues: Say there is also a frying pan
a1-kitchen-01.target: Hay un horno y una sartén en la cocina.
a1-kitchen-01.english: There is an oven and a frying pan in the kitchen.
a1-kitchen-01.canDo: I can name common things found in a kitchen.

a1-kitchen-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Cooking with Carlos
a1-kitchen-02.scenario: You are cooking in Carlos's kitchen and he asks what you are doing. You are making the food and cutting the tomatoes.
a1-kitchen-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you are making the food and cutting the tomatoes.
a1-kitchen-02.target: Hago la comida y corto los tomates.
a1-kitchen-02.english: I'm making the food and cutting the tomatoes.
a1-kitchen-02.canDo: I can describe simple cooking actions.

a1-kitchen-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Helping in the Kitchen
a1-kitchen-03.scenario: You are helping Carlos get dinner ready in his kitchen. He asks what you are doing: you are washing the tomatoes and adding salt.
a1-kitchen-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that you wash the tomatoes and add salt.
a1-kitchen-03.target: Lavo los tomates y añado sal.
a1-kitchen-03.english: I wash the tomatoes and I add salt.
a1-kitchen-03.canDo: I can describe more simple kitchen actions.

a1-kitchen-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Telling Meg What to Do
a1-kitchen-04.scenario: Meg is cooking at Carlos's flat for the first time and asks you what to do. You want her to wash the tomatoes and open the bottle.
a1-kitchen-04.prompt: Tell Meg to wash the tomatoes and open the bottle.
cues: Tell her to wash the tomatoes
Tell her to open the bottle
a1-kitchen-04.target: Lava los tomates y abre la botella.
a1-kitchen-04.english: Wash the tomatoes and open the bottle.
a1-kitchen-04.canDo: I can understand and give basic affirmative tú instructions.

a1-kitchen-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Reading the Recipe
a1-kitchen-05.scenario: Meg and Carlos are cooking in Carlos's kitchen. Carlos asks you to read out the three steps of the recipe: wash the tomatoes, cut them, mix the ingredients.
a1-kitchen-05.prompt: Tell Carlos the three steps of the recipe in order.
a1-kitchen-05.target: Primero, lava los tomates. Después, corta los tomates. Finalmente, mezcla los ingredientes.
a1-kitchen-05.english: First, wash the tomatoes. Then, cut the tomatoes. Finally, mix the ingredients.
a1-kitchen-05.canDo: I can follow a simple recipe in Spanish.

a1-kitchen-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Ready to Cook
a1-kitchen-consolidation.scenario: Meg arrives at Carlos's flat to cook together. She asks you what there is in the kitchen and what she should do first. There is a frying pan, and she should cut the tomatoes.
a1-kitchen-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that there is a frying pan in the kitchen and ask her to cut the tomatoes.
cues: Say there is a frying pan
Tell her to cut the tomatoes, politely
a1-kitchen-consolidation.target: Hay una sartén en la cocina. Corta los tomates, por favor.
a1-kitchen-consolidation.english: There is a frying pan in the kitchen. Cut the tomatoes, please.
a1-kitchen-consolidation.canDo: I can use kitchen vocabulary, regular verbs, and imperatives from earlier A1.

a1-04-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is There?
a1-04-01.scenario: Meg is new to the area around Carlos's flat in Hanoi and asks you what there is nearby. There is a park and a pharmacy.
a1-04-01.prompt: Tell Meg that there is a park and a pharmacy.
cues: Say there is also a pharmacy
a1-04-01.target: Hay un parque y una farmacia.
a1-04-01.english: There is a park and a pharmacy.
a1-04-01.canDo: I can say that something exists.

a1-04-02.title: Communicative Challenge: My Neighbourhood
a1-04-02.scenario: Daniela is new in Hanoi and asks what there is in your neighbourhood. There is a library, a museum and a square.
a1-04-02.prompt: Tell Daniela what there is in your neighbourhood: a library, a museum and a square.
a1-04-02.target: En mi barrio hay una biblioteca, un museo y una plaza.
a1-04-02.english: In my neighbourhood there is a library, a museum and a square.
a1-04-02.canDo: I can name common places in a neighbourhood.

a1-04-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is the Café?
a1-04-03.scenario: Meg is looking for a café in the centre of Hanoi and asks you where things are. The café is nearby and the hotel is over there.
a1-04-03.prompt: Tell Meg that the café is nearby and that the hotel is over there.
a1-04-03.target: La cafetería está cerca y el hotel está allí.
a1-04-03.english: The café is nearby and the hotel is over there.
a1-04-03.canDo: I can say where a person or thing is.

a1-04-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking for the Bank
a1-04-04.scenario: You and Carlos are walking in the centre of Hanoi. You need to find the bank and the pharmacy, and you ask him.
a1-04-04.prompt: Ask Carlos where the bank is and where the pharmacy is.
cues: Ask where the pharmacy is too
a1-04-04.target: ¿Dónde está el banco? ¿Y dónde está la farmacia?
a1-04-04.english: Where is the bank? And where is the pharmacy?
a1-04-04.canDo: I can ask where something is.

a1-04-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Around Town
a1-04-05.scenario: Meg asks what there is in your neighbourhood and where the pharmacy is. There is a park and a pharmacy, and the pharmacy is next to the bank.
a1-04-05.prompt: Tell Meg what there is in your neighbourhood and where the pharmacy is.
cues: Say there is a park and a pharmacy
Say the pharmacy is next to the bank
a1-04-05.target: En mi barrio hay un parque y una farmacia. La farmacia está al lado del banco.
a1-04-05.english: In my neighbourhood there is a park and a pharmacy. The pharmacy is next to the bank.
a1-04-05.canDo: I can describe a neighbourhood with hay and estar.

a1-04-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Centre of Hanoi
a1-04-consolidation.scenario: Carlos asks what there is in the centre of Hanoi. There is a museum, and it is near the square.
a1-04-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that there is a museum in the centre and that it is near the square.
cues: Say there is a museum in the centre
a1-04-consolidation.target: Hay un museo en el centro. Está cerca de la plaza.
a1-04-consolidation.english: There is a museum in the centre. It is near the square.
a1-04-consolidation.canDo: I can say what places there are in an area.

a1-directions-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Going or Being
a1-directions-01.scenario: Carlos phones you on his way to the language exchange in Hanoi and asks where you are going and where you are right now. You are going to the park, and right now you are at the market.
a1-directions-01.prompt: Tell Carlos where you are going and where you are now.
a1-directions-01.target: Voy al parque. Ahora estoy en el mercado.
a1-directions-01.english: I am going to the park. Right now I am at the market.

a1-directions-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Way Do You Walk?
a1-directions-02.scenario: Meg asks which way you walk from your hotel to the centre of Hanoi. You go straight along the street, towards the centre.
a1-directions-02.prompt: Tell Meg that you go straight along the street towards the centre.
cues: Say which way you go: along the street
a1-directions-02.target: Voy recto por la calle hacia el centro.
a1-directions-02.english: I go straight along the street towards the centre.
a1-directions-02.canDo: Use basic words for left, right and straight.

a1-directions-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Turn Left, Then Straight
a1-directions-03.scenario: Meg phones you from the corner of your street in Hanoi. She is looking for your flat and asks what to do next. She must turn left and then continue straight.
a1-directions-03.prompt: Tell Meg to turn left and then continue straight.
cues: Tell her to continue straight afterwards
a1-directions-03.target: Gira a la izquierda. Después sigue recto.
a1-directions-03.canDo: Understand and use basic directional commands.

a1-directions-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Way to the Museum
a1-directions-04.scenario: After the language exchange in Hanoi, Carlos asks you the way to the museum. You know the route: he goes to the centre and turns right, and the museum is on the left.
a1-directions-04.prompt: Tell Carlos the route to the museum.
cues: Tell him where to go first
a1-directions-04.target: Ve al centro y gira a la derecha. El museo está a la izquierda.
a1-directions-04.english: Go to the centre and turn right. The museum is on the left.
a1-directions-04.canDo: Give a short route using familiar direction language.

a1-directions-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is the Pharmacy?
a1-directions-05.scenario: You are walking in Hanoi with Carlos and you need the pharmacy. You ask him where it is and how you get there.
a1-directions-05.prompt: Ask Carlos where the pharmacy is and how to get there.
a1-directions-05.target: ¿Dónde está la farmacia? ¿Cómo voy a la farmacia?
a1-directions-05.english: Where is the pharmacy? How do I get to the pharmacy?
a1-directions-05.canDo: Ask for and give simple directions.

a1-directions-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Bank Nearby
a1-directions-consolidation.scenario: Carlos asks you whether there is a bank near the language exchange in Hanoi and where it is. There is one, to the right of the pharmacy.
a1-directions-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos there is a bank nearby and say where it is.
cues: Say there is a bank nearby
Say it is to the right of the pharmacy
a1-directions-consolidation.target: Hay un banco cerca. Está a la derecha de la farmacia.
a1-directions-consolidation.english: There is a bank nearby. It is to the right of the pharmacy.
a1-directions-consolidation.canDo: I can use directions, town vocabulary, hay, and estar with earlier A1 language.

a1-weather-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hot and Sunny
a1-weather-01.scenario: Meg is about to leave her flat in Hanoi and asks you what the weather is like outside. It is hot and the sun is shining.
a1-weather-01.prompt: Tell Meg that it is hot and sunny.
a1-weather-01.english: It is hot and it is sunny.

a1-weather-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Cloudy and Windy
a1-weather-02.scenario: Carlos phones you from his flat in Hanoi and asks what the weather is like where you are. You look at the sky: it is cloudy, and it is windy.
a1-weather-02.prompt: Tell Carlos it is cloudy and windy.
a1-weather-02.english: It is cloudy and it is windy.

a1-weather-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Rain Today
a1-weather-03.scenario: Meg messages you from the café in Hanoi and asks what you are doing today. It is raining and you are studying at home.
a1-weather-03.prompt: Tell Meg that it is raining today and that you study at home.
cues: Say what you do at home
a1-weather-03.target: Hoy llueve y estudio en casa.
a1-weather-03.english: Today it is raining and I study at home.

a1-weather-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Do You Do?
a1-weather-04.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Carlos asks what you do in different weather. When it is hot you drink water, and when it rains you study at home.
a1-weather-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what you do when it is hot and what you do when it rains.
cues: Say what you do when it is hot
Say what you do when it rains
a1-weather-04.target: Cuando hace calor, tomo agua. Cuando llueve, estudio en casa.
a1-weather-04.english: When it is hot, I drink water. When it rains, I study at home.
a1-weather-04.canDo: Say what you do in different weather.

a1-weather-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Today and Tomorrow
a1-weather-05.scenario: Meg asks about your plans in Hanoi for today and tomorrow. Today is sunny and you go to the park. Tomorrow is cold and you work at home.
a1-weather-05.prompt: Tell Meg the weather and your plan for today and for tomorrow.
cues: Say today's weather and where you go
Say tomorrow's weather and what you do
a1-weather-05.target: Hoy hace sol y voy al parque. Mañana hace frío y trabajo en casa.
a1-weather-05.english: Today it is sunny and I go to the park. Tomorrow it is cold and I work at home.

a1-weather-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Friday in the Heat
a1-weather-consolidation.scenario: Carlos is planning the week in Hanoi. He asks what Friday is like and what you do when it is hot. On Friday it is hot, and when it is hot you drink water.
a1-weather-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what the weather is on Friday and what you do when it is hot.
cues: Say what the weather is on Friday
Say what you do when it is hot
a1-weather-consolidation.target: El viernes hace calor. Cuando hace calor, tomo agua.
a1-weather-consolidation.english: On Friday it is hot. When it is hot, I drink water.
a1-weather-consolidation.canDo: I can use weather vocabulary, present tense, and time expressions.

a1-work-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Do You Do?
a1-work-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Meg asks you what your job is and where you work. You are a journalist and you work in an office.
a1-work-01.prompt: Tell Meg what your job is and where you work.
a1-work-01.target: Soy periodista y trabajo en una oficina.
a1-work-01.english: I am a journalist and I work in an office.

a1-work-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Busy Day
a1-work-02.scenario: Carlos phones you from his flat in Hanoi and asks what you have to do today. You have a meeting, and you have to write a report.
a1-work-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what you have to do today.
cues: Say you have to write a report
a1-work-02.target: Hoy tengo una reunión y tengo que escribir un informe.
a1-work-02.english: Today I have a meeting and I have to write a report.
a1-work-02.canDo: Say what a specific person has to do.

a1-work-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Rules at the Office
a1-work-03.scenario: Meg asks you what the rules are at your office in Hanoi. In general, it is necessary to arrive early and to finish the reports.
a1-work-03.prompt: Tell Meg what the general rules at your office are.
cues: Say the rule about the reports
a1-work-03.target: Hay que llegar temprano y terminar los informes.
a1-work-03.english: You have to arrive early and finish the reports.

a1-work-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Rule and Today
a1-work-04.scenario: Carlos asks you about work at your office in Hanoi. In general it is necessary to arrive early, but today you personally have to arrive at eight.
a1-work-04.prompt: Tell Carlos the general rule and what you have to do today.
cues: Say the general rule about arriving early
Say what you have to do today
a1-work-04.target: Hay que llegar temprano, pero hoy tengo que llegar a las ocho.
a1-work-04.english: You have to arrive early, but today I have to arrive at eight.

a1-work-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Working Day
a1-work-05.scenario: Meg asks you about a normal working day at your office in Hanoi. First you have to work, and afterwards you write reports.
a1-work-05.prompt: Tell Meg what you have to do first and what you do afterwards.
cues: Say what you have to do first
a1-work-05.target: Primero, tengo que trabajar. Después, escribo informes.
a1-work-05.english: First, I have to work. Afterwards, I write reports.

a1-work-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Job
a1-work-consolidation.scenario: Carlos asks you about your job in Hanoi. You work in an office, it is necessary to arrive early, and today you have to write a report.
a1-work-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos where you work, the general rule, and what you have to do today.
cues: Say the general rule about arriving
Say what you have to do today
a1-work-consolidation.target: Trabajo en una oficina. Hay que llegar temprano. Hoy tengo que escribir un informe.
a1-work-consolidation.english: I work in an office. You have to arrive early. Today I have to write a report.
a1-work-consolidation.canDo: I can use work vocabulary, tener que, hay que, and present tense together.

a1-continuous-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Are You Doing?
a1-continuous-01.scenario: Meg phones you at home in Hanoi and asks what you are doing. You are cooking dinner.
a1-continuous-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you are doing right now.
cues: Say it is happening right now
a1-continuous-01.target: Estoy cocinando la cena ahora mismo.
a1-continuous-01.english: I am cooking dinner right now.
a1-continuous-01.canDo: I can describe what people are doing right now using estar + -ando.

a1-continuous-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Coffee and a Message
a1-continuous-02.scenario: Carlos phones you and asks what you are doing. You are sitting on the terrace, drinking coffee and writing a message.
a1-continuous-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you are drinking coffee and writing a message.
cues: Say you are also writing a message
a1-continuous-02.target: Estoy bebiendo café y escribiendo un mensaje.
a1-continuous-02.english: I am drinking coffee and writing a message.
a1-continuous-02.canDo: I can form the continuous of -er and -ir verbs with -iendo.

a1-continuous-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Novel on the Sofa
a1-continuous-03.scenario: Meg calls you from the café in Hanoi and asks what you are doing. You are lying on the sofa, reading a novel.
a1-continuous-03.prompt: Tell Meg that you are reading a novel on the sofa.
cues: Say you are reading a novel
a1-continuous-03.target: Estoy leyendo una novela en el sofá.
a1-continuous-03.english: I am reading a novel on the sofa.
a1-continuous-03.canDo: I can use irregular gerunds like leyendo, durmiendo, and yendo.

a1-continuous-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Coffee or Tea Today
a1-continuous-04.scenario: Carlos asks what you drink in the afternoon. You normally drink coffee, but today you are drinking tea.
a1-continuous-04.prompt: Tell Carlos that you normally drink coffee, but today you are drinking tea.
cues: Say what you are drinking today
a1-continuous-04.target: Normalmente bebo café, pero hoy estoy bebiendo té.
a1-continuous-04.english: Normally I drink coffee, but today I am drinking tea.
a1-continuous-04.canDo: I can tell when to use the simple present and when to use the present continuous.

a1-continuous-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Almost There
a1-continuous-05.scenario: You are meeting Meg at the café in Hanoi. She phones you and asks where you are. You are arriving at the station.
a1-continuous-05.prompt: Tell Meg that you are arriving at the station.
a1-continuous-05.english: I am arriving at the station.
a1-continuous-05.canDo: I can answer the phone and describe what I am doing in real time.

a1-continuous-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Lunch in the Centre
a1-continuous-consolidation.scenario: Carlos phones you from his office in Hanoi and asks what you and Meg are doing. You are eating at a café in the centre.
a1-continuous-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that you and Meg are eating at a café in the centre.
a1-continuous-consolidation.target: Meg y yo estamos comiendo en un café del centro.
a1-continuous-consolidation.english: Meg and I are eating at a café in the centre.
a1-continuous-consolidation.canDo: I can form -ando and -iendo gerunds for all regular verb types.

a1-health-01.title: Communicative Challenge: How Is Carlos?
a1-health-01.scenario: Daniela phones you from the school in Hanoi and asks how Carlos is today. He is sick and very tired.
a1-health-01.prompt: Tell Daniela that Carlos is sick and tired.
a1-health-01.canDo: Name basic body and health vocabulary.

a1-health-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Sore Throat
a1-health-02.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Carlos sees you drinking tea and asks what is wrong. You have a sore throat.
a1-health-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have a sore throat.
cues: Say which part of the body hurts
a1-health-02.canDo: Say what common health problem you have.

a1-health-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Symptoms
a1-health-03.scenario: Meg phones you in Hanoi and asks about your symptoms. You have a fever and a cough.
a1-health-03.prompt: Tell Meg that you have a fever and a cough.
cues: Say you also have a cough
a1-health-03.english: I have a fever and a cough.
a1-health-03.canDo: Name common symptoms and health problems.

a1-health-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is Wrong, Carlos?
a1-health-04.scenario: Carlos arrives at the café in Hanoi looking pale. You want to know what is wrong and whether he has a fever.
a1-health-04.prompt: Ask Carlos what he has and whether he has a fever.
cues: Ask if he has a fever
a1-health-04.english: What is wrong, Carlos? Do you have a fever?
a1-health-04.canDo: Ask and answer simple questions about symptoms.

a1-health-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Rest and Water
a1-health-05.scenario: Carlos tells you in Hanoi that he has a fever and does not feel well. You give him simple advice.
a1-health-05.prompt: Tell Carlos to rest and drink water.
a1-health-05.canDo: Give simple health advice using familiar commands.

a1-health-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking After Meg
a1-health-consolidation.scenario: Meg stays home in Hanoi with a cough and calls you. You want to know what is wrong and then give her advice.
a1-health-consolidation.prompt: Ask Meg what she has and tell her to rest and drink water.
a1-health-consolidation.target: ¿Qué tienes, Meg? Descansa y toma agua.
a1-health-consolidation.english: What is wrong, Meg? Rest and drink water.
a1-health-consolidation.canDo: I can use health vocabulary, tener expressions, questions, and commands.

a1-doler-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Sore Feet
a1-doler-01.scenario: You are walking through the old town in Hanoi with Meg. After a long walk your feet hurt and you want to stop.
a1-doler-01.prompt: Tell Meg that your feet hurt.
cues: Say which part of the body, more than one
a1-doler-01.canDo: I can say what hurts using me duele and me duelen correctly.

a1-doler-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Does It Hurt?
a1-doler-02.scenario: Carlos stops on the street in Hanoi and holds his leg. You think it is his knee.
a1-doler-02.prompt: Ask Carlos where it hurts and whether his knee hurts.
a1-doler-02.target: ¿Dónde te duele, Carlos? ¿Te duele la rodilla?
a1-doler-02.english: Where does it hurt, Carlos? Does your knee hurt?
a1-doler-02.canDo: I can ask someone where it hurts and talk about someone else's aches.

a1-doler-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Little Sore Throat
a1-doler-03.scenario: Meg phones you in Hanoi and asks how you are. Your throat hurts a little and you have a cough.
a1-doler-03.prompt: Tell Meg that your throat hurts a little and that you have a cough.
cues: Say what hurts and how much
a1-doler-03.target: Me duele un poco la garganta y tengo tos.
a1-doler-03.english: My throat hurts a little and I have a cough.
a1-doler-03.canDo: I can describe how strong my pain is and how I feel physically.

a1-doler-04.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Pharmacy
a1-doler-04.scenario: You are at a pharmacy in Hanoi. You have a headache and want something for it.
a1-doler-04.prompt: Ask the pharmacist for something for a headache.
a1-doler-04.target: Buenos días, ¿tiene algo para el dolor de cabeza?
a1-doler-04.english: Good morning, do you have something for a headache?
a1-doler-04.canDo: I can ask for medicine and remedies at a Spanish pharmacy.

a1-doler-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Ways to Say It
a1-doler-05.scenario: Carlos asks you what is wrong at the café in Hanoi. You have a headache and want to say it in both ways you know.
a1-doler-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have a headache, first with tener and then with doler.
a1-doler-05.target: Tengo dolor de cabeza. Me duele la cabeza.
a1-doler-05.english: I have a headache. My head hurts.
a1-doler-05.canDo: I can express pain using both me duele and tengo dolor de with equal confidence.

a1-doler-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Sore Feet at the Pharmacy
a1-doler-consolidation.scenario: Meg waits outside a pharmacy in Hanoi after a long walk. You go in to help her.
a1-doler-consolidation.prompt: Tell the pharmacist that Meg's feet hurt and ask if they have something for the pain.
cues: Ask for something for the pain
a1-doler-consolidation.target: A Meg le duelen los pies. ¿Tiene algo para el dolor?
a1-doler-consolidation.english: Meg's feet hurt. Do you have something for the pain?
a1-doler-consolidation.canDo: I can use duele vs. duelen correctly with singular and plural body parts.

a1-gustar-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Coffee or Tea?
a1-gustar-01.scenario: You are at a café in Hanoi with Carlos. He asks whether you want coffee or tea. You like coffee.
a1-gustar-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that you like coffee.
a1-gustar-01.canDo: I can say what I like with me gusta.

a1-gustar-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Apples at the Market
a1-gustar-02.scenario: You are shopping at a market in Hanoi with Meg. She holds up some apples and asks what you think. You like them.
a1-gustar-02.prompt: Tell Meg that you like apples.
a1-gustar-02.canDo: I can choose between gusta and gustan according to the noun.

a1-gustar-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Music in the Café
a1-gustar-03.scenario: You are sitting with Carlos at a café in Hanoi and music is playing. You want to know whether he likes it.
a1-gustar-03.prompt: Ask Carlos if he likes the music.
a1-gustar-03.canDo: I can ask questions using ¿te gusta...?

a1-gustar-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Weekend Hobbies
a1-gustar-04.scenario: Meg asks what you like to do at home at the weekend. You like reading and cooking.
a1-gustar-04.prompt: Tell Meg two things you like to do.
a1-gustar-04.english: I like to read and to cook.
a1-gustar-04.canDo: I can talk about my hobbies with me gusta + infinitive.

a1-gustar-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Favourite City
a1-gustar-05.scenario: You are walking around Hanoi with Carlos. He asks whether you like the city. You love it.
a1-gustar-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that you love the city.
a1-gustar-05.canDo: I can say what I love with me encanta.

a1-gustar-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Likes at the Café
a1-gustar-consolidation.scenario: At the café in Hanoi, Meg asks what you and Carlos like to drink. Carlos likes coffee and you love tea.
a1-gustar-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what Carlos likes and what you love.
a1-gustar-consolidation.target: A Carlos le gusta el café y a mí me encanta el té.
a1-gustar-consolidation.english: Carlos likes coffee and I love tea.
a1-gustar-consolidation.canDo: I can use gustar with nouns and infinitives.

a1-hobbies-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Afternoons at Home
a1-hobbies-01.scenario: You are at the language exchange in Hanoi. Meg asks what you do in the afternoon. You usually read at home.
a1-hobbies-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you read at home in the afternoon.
a1-hobbies-01.target: Leo en casa por la tarde.
a1-hobbies-01.english: I read at home in the afternoon.
a1-hobbies-01.canDo: I can talk about familiar free-time activities.

a1-hobbies-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Fridays in the Park
a1-hobbies-02.scenario: Carlos asks what you do on Friday afternoons. You walk in the park and then study Spanish.
a1-hobbies-02.prompt: Tell Carlos two things you do on Fridays.
a1-hobbies-02.target: Camino en el parque y estudio español.
a1-hobbies-02.english: I walk in the park and I study Spanish.
a1-hobbies-02.canDo: I can name common hobbies and activities.

a1-hobbies-03.title: Communicative Challenge: My Weekly Routine
a1-hobbies-03.scenario: You are in the park in Hanoi with Daniela, who asks about your free-time routine. On Saturdays you play football and every week you listen to music.
a1-hobbies-03.prompt: Tell Daniela what you do on Saturdays and what you do every week.
cues: Say what you do on Saturdays
Say what you do every week
a1-hobbies-03.target: Los sábados juego al fútbol y cada semana escucho música.
a1-hobbies-03.english: On Saturdays I play football and every week I listen to music.
a1-hobbies-03.canDo: I can describe my habitual free-time routines.

a1-hobbies-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting to Know Meg
a1-hobbies-04.scenario: You meet Meg at the language exchange in Hanoi and want to know her better. You are curious about her free time and about music.
a1-hobbies-04.prompt: Ask Meg what she does in her free time and whether she likes music.
cues: Ask what she does in her free time
a1-hobbies-04.target: ¿Qué haces en tu tiempo libre? ¿Te gusta la música?
a1-hobbies-04.english: What do you do in your free time? Do you like music?
a1-hobbies-04.canDo: I can ask simple questions about hobbies.

a1-hobbies-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Week
a1-hobbies-05.scenario: Carlos asks you about your week. You read at home on Monday, go out with your friends on Friday and rest on Sunday.
a1-hobbies-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what you do on Monday, Friday and Sunday.
cues: Say what you do on Monday
Say your plan with friends on Friday
Say what you do on Sunday
a1-hobbies-05.target: El lunes leo en casa, el viernes salgo con mis amigos y el domingo descanso.
a1-hobbies-05.english: On Monday I read at home, on Friday I go out with my friends and on Sunday I rest.
a1-hobbies-05.canDo: I can describe a simple week of hobbies and free-time activities.

a1-hobbies-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Weekends in the Park
a1-hobbies-consolidation.scenario: You are in the park in Hanoi and Daniela asks what you like doing at weekends. You like reading, and on Sundays you rest.
a1-hobbies-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela what you like doing at weekends and what you do on Sundays.
cues: Say what you like doing at weekends
Say what you do on Sundays
a1-hobbies-consolidation.target: Los fines de semana me gusta leer y los domingos descanso.
a1-hobbies-consolidation.english: On weekends I like to read and on Sundays I rest.
a1-hobbies-consolidation.canDo: I can use hobby vocabulary, present tense, questions, and time expressions.

a1-abilities-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Favor at the Library
a1-abilities-01.scenario: You are studying with Carlos at the library in Hanoi and you do not understand a rule from your Spanish class.
a1-abilities-01.prompt: Ask Carlos politely to explain the rule.
cues: Ask Carlos if he can do it
Say what you want him to explain
a1-abilities-01.target: Carlos, ¿puedes explicar la regla, por favor?
a1-abilities-01.english: Carlos, can you explain the rule, please?
a1-abilities-01.canDo: I can say what I can do and make polite requests with poder.

a1-abilities-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Do You Know How to Do?
a1-abilities-02.scenario: Meg asks what you know how to do. You know how to swim and how to cook.
a1-abilities-02.prompt: Tell Meg two things you know how to do.
cues: Say you know how to swim
Say you also know how to cook
a1-abilities-02.english: I know how to swim and I know how to cook.
a1-abilities-02.canDo: I can describe skills I know how to do using saber + infinitive.

a1-abilities-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Hanoi and the Museum
a1-abilities-03.scenario: You are walking around Hanoi with Carlos. He asks whether you know the city and the museum. You are familiar with Hanoi, but you do not know the museum's address.
a1-abilities-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that you are familiar with Hanoi but do not know the museum's address.
cues: Say you are familiar with the city
Say you do not know the address
a1-abilities-03.target: Conozco Hanói, pero no sé la dirección del museo.
a1-abilities-03.english: I know Hanoi, but I do not know the museum's address.
a1-abilities-03.canDo: I can use saber for facts and conocer for people and places.

a1-abilities-04.title: Communicative Challenge: People I Know
a1-abilities-04.scenario: Meg asks about the people around you in Hanoi. You know Carlos from the language class, and you see your teacher every day.
a1-abilities-04.prompt: Tell Meg that you know Carlos and that you see the teacher every day.
a1-abilities-04.target: Conozco a Carlos y veo a la profesora todos los días.
a1-abilities-04.english: I know Carlos and I see the teacher every day.
a1-abilities-04.canDo: I can use the personal a before a specific person.

a1-abilities-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Help with a Heavy Bag
a1-abilities-05.scenario: You are at the library in Hanoi and your bag is very heavy. Carlos is sitting next to you.
a1-abilities-05.prompt: Ask Carlos to help you with the bag and thank him.
cues: Say what you need help with
a1-abilities-05.target: ¿Me puedes ayudar con la bolsa? Muchas gracias por tu ayuda.
a1-abilities-05.english: Can you help me with the bag? Thank you very much for your help.
a1-abilities-05.canDo: I can ask for favors and offer help naturally in everyday conversations.

a1-abilities-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Dinner and Piano
a1-abilities-consolidation.scenario: Carlos is planning a dinner with music in Hanoi and asks you to play the piano. You know how to play it, but today you cannot come.
a1-abilities-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what you know how to do and that you cannot come today.
cues: Say what you know how to play
a1-abilities-consolidation.target: Sé tocar el piano, pero hoy no puedo venir.
a1-abilities-consolidation.english: I know how to play the piano, but today I cannot come.
a1-abilities-consolidation.canDo: I can use poder vs. saber to talk about abilities and opportunities.

a1-future-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans for Today
a1-future-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Carlos asks what you are going to do today. You are going to study this afternoon.
a1-future-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that you are going to study this afternoon.
cues: Say you are going to study
a1-future-01.english: I am going to study this afternoon.

a1-future-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Weekend Plans
a1-future-02.scenario: After class in Hanoi, Daniela asks what you are doing this weekend. On Saturday you are going to cook, and on Sunday you are going to visit your family.
a1-future-02.prompt: Tell Daniela what you are going to do on Saturday and on Sunday.
cues: Say what you are going to do on Saturday
Say what you are going to do on Sunday
a1-future-02.target: El sábado voy a cocinar y el domingo voy a visitar a mi familia.
a1-future-02.english: On Saturday I am going to cook and on Sunday I am going to visit my family.

a1-future-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Where and When?
a1-future-03.scenario: Meg tells you she is going on a trip next week. You want to know where she is going to go and when she is going to travel.
a1-future-03.prompt: Ask Meg where she is going to go and when she is going to travel.
cues: Ask where she is going to go
Ask when she is going to travel
a1-future-03.target: ¿Adónde vas a ir? ¿Cuándo vas a viajar?
a1-future-03.english: Where are you going to go? When are you going to travel?

a1-future-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans and Things To Do
a1-future-04.scenario: At a café in Hanoi, Daniela asks about your plans for the holidays. You are going to travel, but first you have to book a hotel.
a1-future-04.prompt: Tell Daniela that you are going to travel and that you have to book a hotel.
cues: Say you are going to travel
Say you have to book a hotel
a1-future-04.target: Voy a viajar y tengo que reservar el hotel.
a1-future-04.english: I am going to travel and I have to book the hotel.
a1-future-04.canDo: Talk about future plans and personal obligations.

a1-future-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Holiday Trip
a1-future-05.scenario: The term is ending and Daniela asks about your holiday trip. Next week you are going to travel, on Saturday you are going to take the train, and you have to prepare your suitcase.
