a1-future-05.prompt: Tell Daniela about your trip: next week, Saturday and your suitcase.
cues: Say you are going to travel next week
Say you are going to take the train on Saturday
Say you have to prepare your suitcase
a1-future-05.target: La próxima semana voy a viajar. El sábado voy a tomar el tren. Tengo que preparar la maleta.
a1-future-05.english: Next week I am going to travel. On Saturday I am going to take the train. I have to prepare my suitcase.
a1-future-05.canDo: Describe an upcoming trip or weekend.

a1-future-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Work First, Then Rest
a1-future-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks about your week in Hanoi. On Friday you have to finish your work, and on Sunday you are going to rest.
a1-future-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you have to do on Friday and what you are going to do on Sunday.
cues: Say what you have to do on Friday
Say what you are going to do on Sunday
a1-future-consolidation.target: El viernes tengo que terminar el trabajo y el domingo voy a descansar.
a1-future-consolidation.english: On Friday I have to finish my work and on Sunday I am going to rest.
a1-future-consolidation.canDo: I can use ir a + infinitive and tener que with time expressions.

a1-20-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Trip
a1-20-01.scenario: In Hanoi the night before the train trip, Meg asks what you have to do before you leave. You have to prepare your suitcase and check your ticket.
a1-20-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you have to do before the trip.
cues: Say you have to prepare the suitcase
Say you also have to check the ticket
a1-20-01.target: Tengo que preparar la maleta y comprobar el billete.
a1-20-01.english: I have to prepare the suitcase and check the ticket.

a1-20-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Have and Need
a1-20-02.scenario: At the station in Hanoi, Carlos asks what you have and what you need for the trip. You have a ticket, but you need water.
a1-20-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what you have and what you need.
a1-20-02.target: Tengo un billete, pero necesito agua.
a1-20-02.english: I have a ticket, but I need water.

a1-20-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Asking at the Station
a1-20-03.scenario: You are at the train station in Hanoi with Meg. At the information desk you want to know where platform three is and what time the train leaves.
a1-20-03.prompt: Ask the employee where platform three is and what time the train leaves.
cues: Ask what time the train leaves
a1-20-03.target: Perdón, ¿dónde está el andén tres? ¿A qué hora sale el tren?
a1-20-03.english: Excuse me, where is platform three? What time does the train leave?
a1-20-03.canDo: Ask practical questions at a station.

a1-20-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are You Going?
a1-20-04.scenario: Meg meets you in the street in Hanoi and asks where you are going. You are going to the station, and you are going to take the train.
a1-20-04.prompt: Tell Meg where you are going and what you are going to do.
cues: Say what you are going to do
a1-20-04.target: Voy a la estación. Voy a tomar el tren.
a1-20-04.english: I am going to the station. I am going to take the train.
a1-20-04.canDo: Talk about where you are going.

a1-20-05.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Station
a1-20-05.scenario: It is Saturday morning and you are at the station with Carlos. He asks if you are ready. You need your ticket, you have to go to the platform and you are going to take the train.
a1-20-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what you need, what you have to do and what you are going to do.
cues: Say where you have to go
Say what you are going to do
a1-20-05.target: Necesito mi billete. Tengo que ir al andén. Voy a tomar el tren.
a1-20-05.english: I need my ticket. I have to go to the platform. I am going to take the train.
a1-20-05.canDo: Describe the start of a journey.

a1-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Packing with Meg
a1-20-consolidation.scenario: Meg is helping you pack in Hanoi. She asks what you have, what you need and what you have to do tonight. You have your ticket, you need water, and you have to prepare the suitcase.
a1-20-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you have, what you need and what you have to do.
cues: Say what you have to do
a1-20-consolidation.target: Tengo mi billete, necesito agua y tengo que preparar la maleta.
a1-20-consolidation.english: I have my ticket, I need water and I have to prepare the suitcase.
a1-20-consolidation.canDo: I can use travel vocabulary, tener que, tener, querer, and necesitar.

a2-01-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Arrived at the Hotel
a2-01-01.scenario: You and the group have just reached the hotel in Ninh Bình. Meg's sister Lauren asks what you have done today. You have travelled by train and you have arrived at the hotel.
a2-01-01.prompt: Tell Lauren that you have travelled by train today and that you have arrived at the hotel.
cues: Say how you have travelled today
a2-01-01.target: Hoy he viajado en tren y he llegado al hotel.
a2-01-01.english: Today I have travelled by train and I have arrived at the hotel.
a2-01-01.canDo: I can talk about a recent travel experience using regular pretérito perfecto forms.

a2-01-02.title: Communicative Challenge: This Afternoon
a2-01-02.scenario: It is the first afternoon in Ninh Bình. Daniela asks what you have done. You have seen the mountains and you have written a message to a friend.
a2-01-02.prompt: Tell Daniela that this afternoon you have seen the mountains and written a message.
a2-01-02.target: Esta tarde he visto las montañas y he escrito un mensaje.
a2-01-02.english: This afternoon I have seen the mountains and I have written a message.
a2-01-02.canDo: I can describe recent actions using common irregular past participles.

a2-01-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Questions at Dinner
a2-01-03.scenario: At dinner in Ninh Bình you sit next to Meg's sister Kaylee. You want to know if she has travelled by train and what she has done today.
a2-01-03.prompt: Ask Kaylee whether she has travelled by train and what she has done today.
cues: Ask if she has travelled by train
Ask what she has done today
a2-01-03.target: ¿Has viajado en tren? ¿Qué has hecho hoy?
a2-01-03.english: Have you travelled by train? What have you done today?
a2-01-03.canDo: I can ask and answer simple questions about recent experiences.

a2-01-04.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Reception
a2-01-04.scenario: You are Carlos at the small hotel in Ninh Bình. The receptionist asks whether you have booked a room. You have booked one and you have arrived this morning.
a2-01-04.prompt: Tell the receptionist that you have booked a room and that you have arrived this morning.
a2-01-04.target: Sí, he reservado una habitación. He llegado esta mañana.
a2-01-04.english: Yes, I have booked a room. I have arrived this morning.
a2-01-04.canDo: I can describe recent travel and accommodation experiences.

a2-01-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Walk
a2-01-05.scenario: In the evening in Ninh Bình, Meg asks what you and the others have seen on your walk. You have seen rivers and mountains and you have taken many photos.
a2-01-05.prompt: Tell Meg what you have seen and that you have taken many photos.
cues: Say what you have all seen
Say what you have done with the camera
a2-01-05.target: Hemos visto ríos y montañas. He hecho muchas fotos.
a2-01-05.english: We have seen rivers and mountains. I have taken many photos.
a2-01-05.canDo: I can describe what I have done during a recent arrival and trip.

a2-01-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The First Day
a2-01-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the first day in Ninh Bình, Meg phones from her room and asks about your day. You have travelled by train, you have arrived at the hotel, you have booked a room and you have seen the mountains.
a2-01-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you have done today: your trip, the hotel and what you have seen.
cues: Say how you have travelled and where you have arrived
a2-01-consolidation.target: Hemos viajado en tren y hemos llegado al hotel. He reservado una habitación y he visto las montañas.
a2-01-consolidation.english: We have travelled by train and we have arrived at the hotel. I have booked a room and I have seen the mountains.
a2-01-consolidation.canDo: I can use the Unit 1 pretérito perfecto forms in simple travel contexts.

a2-02-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Ride
a2-02-01.scenario: The group is about to go cycling around Ninh Bình. Daniela asks whether you have sorted out the bicycles and the map. You have rented a bicycle and you have bought a map.
a2-02-01.prompt: Tell Daniela that you have already rented a bicycle and already bought a map.
cues: Say what you have already rented
Say what you have already bought
a2-02-01.target: Ya he alquilado una bicicleta y ya he comprado un mapa.
a2-02-01.english: I have already rented a bicycle and I have already bought a map.
a2-02-01.canDo: I can say what I have already done using ya + pretérito perfecto.

a2-02-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Yet
a2-02-02.scenario: In Ninh Bình, Meg's sister Lauren asks whether you have already seen the temple and visited the rice field. You have done neither yet.
a2-02-02.prompt: Tell Lauren that you have not seen the temple yet and have not visited the rice field yet.
cues: Say you have not seen the temple yet
Say you have not visited the rice field yet
a2-02-02.target: Todavía no he visto el templo. Todavía no he visitado el arrozal.
a2-02-02.english: I have not seen the temple yet. I have not visited the rice field yet.
a2-02-02.canDo: I can say what I have not done yet using todavía no + pretérito perfecto.

a2-02-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Have You Already...?
a2-02-03.scenario: On the bike ride near Ninh Bình you are riding next to Meg's sister Kaylee. You want to find out whether she has already seen the mountains and whether she has already travelled by boat on the river.
a2-02-03.prompt: Ask Kaylee whether she has already seen the mountains and whether she has already travelled by boat on the river.
cues: Ask if she has already seen the mountains
Ask if she has already travelled by boat
a2-02-03.target: ¿Ya has visto las montañas? ¿Ya has navegado por el río?
a2-02-03.english: Have you already seen the mountains? Have you already travelled by boat on the river?
a2-02-03.canDo: I can ask and answer questions about what someone has already done or has not done yet.

a2-02-04.title: Communicative Challenge: On the Way
a2-02-04.scenario: The group is halfway through the bike ride near Ninh Bình. Meg asks how it is going. You have already travelled along the path, but you have not arrived at the village yet.
a2-02-04.prompt: Tell Meg that you have already travelled along the path and that you have not arrived at the village yet.
cues: Say what you have already done on the path
Say what you have not done yet
a2-02-04.target: Ya hemos recorrido el camino y todavía no hemos llegado al pueblo.
a2-02-04.english: We have already travelled along the path and we have not arrived at the village yet.
a2-02-04.canDo: I can talk about things I have already done and things I have not done yet while travelling.

a2-02-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bike Ride
a2-02-05.scenario: At the end of the bike ride in Ninh Bình, Daniela asks about the day. You have rented the bicycles and seen the rice fields, but you have not travelled by boat between the mountains yet.
a2-02-05.prompt: Tell Daniela what you have already done today and what you have not done yet.
cues: Say what you have already rented
Say what you have already seen
Say what you have not done yet
a2-02-05.target: Ya hemos alquilado las bicicletas y ya hemos visto los arrozales. Todavía no hemos navegado entre las montañas.
a2-02-05.english: We have already rented the bicycles and we have already seen the rice fields. We have not travelled by boat between the mountains yet.
a2-02-05.canDo: I can describe a bike ride using the pretérito perfecto with ya and todavía no.

a2-02-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Already and Not Yet
a2-02-consolidation.scenario: In the evening in Ninh Bình, Meg's sister Lauren asks you about the day. You have already seen the landscape, but you have not seen the temple yet.
a2-02-consolidation.prompt: Tell Lauren what you have already seen and what you have not seen yet.
cues: Say what you have already seen
Say what you have not seen yet
a2-02-consolidation.target: Ya he visto el paisaje. Todavía no he visto el templo.
a2-02-consolidation.english: I have already seen the landscape. I have not seen the temple yet.
a2-02-consolidation.canDo: I can say what I have already done and what I have not done yet.

a2-03-01.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Pier
a2-03-01.scenario: The group is at the pier in Tam Cốc. Meg asks what you have done today. This morning you arrived at the pier and you saw the caves.
a2-03-01.prompt: Tell Meg that this morning you have arrived at the pier and that you have seen the caves.
a2-03-01.target: Esta mañana hemos llegado al embarcadero y hemos visto las cuevas.
a2-03-01.english: This morning we have arrived at the pier and we have seen the caves.
a2-03-01.canDo: I can say what I have done today, this morning or this afternoon using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-03-02.title: Communicative Challenge: This Week, This Year
a2-03-02.scenario: In the boat, Daniela asks about your trip. This week you have crossed the river, and this year you have travelled a lot.
a2-03-02.prompt: Tell Daniela what you have done this week and what you have done this year.
cues: Say what you have crossed this week
Say what you have done this year
a2-03-02.target: Esta semana hemos atravesado el río. Este año he viajado mucho.
a2-03-02.english: This week we have crossed the river. This year I have travelled a lot.
a2-03-02.canDo: I can say what I have done this week, this weekend, this month or this year.

a2-03-03.title: Communicative Challenge: So Far and Lately
a2-03-03.scenario: At the market near the river, Kaylee asks how the trip is going. So far you have seen three caves, and you have not tried the fruit yet.
a2-03-03.prompt: Tell Kaylee what you have seen so far and what you have not tried yet.
cues: Say what you have seen so far
Say what you have not tried yet
a2-03-03.target: Hasta ahora hemos visto tres cuevas. Todavía no hemos probado la fruta.
a2-03-03.english: So far we have seen three caves. We have not tried the fruit yet.
a2-03-03.canDo: I can say what I have done so far and lately, and what I have already done or not done yet.

a2-03-04.title: Communicative Challenge: On the Terrace
a2-03-04.scenario: On the terrace, Lauren asks about the day. You have visited the market this morning and you have rested on the terrace this afternoon.
a2-03-04.prompt: Tell Lauren that you have visited the market this morning, with the time word at the end, and that you have rested on the terrace this afternoon, with the time word at the start.
cues: Say where you went, then when
Say when, then where you have rested
a2-03-04.target: Hemos visitado el mercado esta mañana. Esta tarde hemos descansado en la terraza.
a2-03-04.english: We have visited the market this morning. This afternoon we have rested on the terrace.
a2-03-04.canDo: I can put a time word at the start or at the end of a sentence with the pretérito perfecto.

a2-03-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Boat Trip
a2-03-05.scenario: Back at the hotel, Lauren asks about the boat trip. So far you have seen very beautiful places, and you have not tried typical food yet.
a2-03-05.prompt: Tell Lauren what you have seen so far and what you have not tried yet.
cues: Say what you have seen so far
Say what you have not tried yet
a2-03-05.target: Hasta ahora hemos visto lugares muy bonitos. Todavía no hemos probado la comida típica.
a2-03-05.english: So far we have seen very beautiful places. We have not tried the typical food yet.
a2-03-05.canDo: I can tell the story of a boat trip using the pretérito perfecto with the right time words.

a2-03-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Outing
a2-03-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the outing in Tam Cốc, Meg asks about the day. Today you have rowed on the river, and you have not tried the typical food yet.
a2-03-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you have done today and what you have not tried yet.
cues: Say what you have done today
Say what you have not tried yet
a2-03-consolidation.target: Hoy hemos remado en el río. Todavía no hemos probado la comida típica.
a2-03-consolidation.english: Today we have rowed on the river. We have not tried the typical food yet.
a2-03-consolidation.canDo: I can use the right time word with the pretérito perfecto to talk about a day out.

a2-04-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Before We Start
a2-04-01.scenario: At the cooking school in Ninh Bình, Daniela asks what you have done before the lesson starts. You have prepared the ingredients and the lesson has not begun yet.
a2-04-01.prompt: Tell Daniela that you have prepared the ingredients before cooking.
cues: Say that it was before cooking
a2-04-01.target: He preparado los ingredientes antes de cocinar.
a2-04-01.english: I have prepared the ingredients before cooking.
a2-04-01.canDo: I can say what I have done before starting a cooking activity.

a2-04-02.title: Communicative Challenge: After Mixing
a2-04-02.scenario: In the cooking school kitchen, Meg asks how the sauce is going. You mixed the ingredients first and then prepared the sauce.
a2-04-02.prompt: Tell Meg that you have prepared the sauce after mixing the ingredients.
a2-04-02.target: He preparado la salsa después de mezclar los ingredientes.
a2-04-02.english: I have prepared the sauce after mixing the ingredients.
a2-04-02.canDo: I can say what I have done after completing a cooking activity.

a2-04-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Right Order
a2-04-03.scenario: Kaylee is writing down the order of the steps for the recipe and asks what you have done. You cut the vegetables before cooking and tasted the food after cooking.
a2-04-03.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you have cut the vegetables before cooking and have tasted the food after cooking.
cues: Say what you did before cooking
Say what you did after cooking
a2-04-03.target: He cortado las verduras antes de cocinar. He probado la comida después de cocinar.
a2-04-03.english: I have cut the vegetables before cooking. I have tasted the food after cooking.
a2-04-03.canDo: I can sequence cooking actions using antes de and después de.

a2-04-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Following the Recipe
a2-04-04.scenario: Daniela is helping at the stove and asks about your steps. You have heated the frying pan before cooking and served the food after cooking.
a2-04-04.prompt: Tell Daniela that you have heated the frying pan before cooking and have served the food after cooking.
cues: Say what you heated, and when
Say what you served, and when
a2-04-04.target: He calentado la sartén antes de cocinar. He servido la comida después de cocinar.
a2-04-04.english: I have heated the frying pan before cooking. I have served the food after cooking.
a2-04-04.canDo: I can describe cooking steps in sequence using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-04-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Cooking Class
a2-04-05.scenario: The cooking class in Ninh Bình is over and Lauren asks what you have done in it. Before cooking you prepared the ingredients, and after cooking you tasted the dish.
a2-04-05.prompt: Tell Lauren what you have done before cooking and what you have done after cooking.
cues: Say what you did before cooking
Say what you did after cooking
a2-04-05.target: Antes de cocinar, he preparado los ingredientes. Después de cocinar, he probado el plato.
a2-04-05.english: Before cooking, I have prepared the ingredients. After cooking, I have tasted the dish.
a2-04-05.canDo: I can describe a cooking class using the pretérito perfecto with antes de and después de.

a2-04-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Back at the Hotel
a2-04-consolidation.scenario: Back at the hotel, Carlos asks what you have done in the cooking class. You mixed the ingredients before cooking and tasted the sauce after cooking.
a2-04-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have mixed the ingredients before cooking and tasted the sauce after cooking.
cues: Say what you did before cooking
Say what you did after cooking
a2-04-consolidation.target: He mezclado los ingredientes antes de cocinar. He probado la salsa después de cocinar.
a2-04-consolidation.english: I have mixed the ingredients before cooking. I have tasted the sauce after cooking.
a2-04-consolidation.canDo: I can describe what I have done before and after an activity.

a2-05-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Are You Sitting Down?
a2-05-01.scenario: On the trail near Ninh Bình, Lauren sees you sitting on a stone and asks why you have stopped. You are tired.
a2-05-01.prompt: Tell Lauren that you have rested because you are tired.
a2-05-01.english: I have rested because I am tired.
a2-05-01.canDo: I can give a reason for a recent action using porque with the pretérito perfecto.

a2-05-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Back Already
a2-05-02.scenario: At the hotel in Ninh Bình, Kaylee is surprised to see you back so early and asks what has happened. It has rained.
a2-05-02.prompt: Tell Kaylee that it has rained, so you have gone back to the hotel.
cues: Say what you did as a result
a2-05-02.target: Ha llovido, por eso he vuelto al hotel.
a2-05-02.english: It has rained, so I have gone back to the hotel.
a2-05-02.canDo: I can explain a consequence of a recent action using por eso.

a2-05-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Wet and Cold
a2-05-03.scenario: Carlos meets you at the hotel in Ninh Bình and asks why you look so wet. You got wet because it rained, so you came back.
a2-05-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have got wet because it has rained, so you have returned.
cues: Give the reason you got wet
Say what you did as a result
a2-05-03.target: Me he mojado porque ha llovido, por eso he vuelto.
a2-05-03.english: I have got wet because it has rained, so I have returned.
a2-05-03.canDo: I can connect reasons and consequences using porque and por eso with the pretérito perfecto.

a2-05-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Did You Think?
a2-05-04.scenario: After the excursion near Ninh Bình, Meg asks what you think of it. You found it interesting because you saw the landscape.
a2-05-04.prompt: Tell Meg that you think the excursion has been interesting because you have seen the landscape.
a2-05-04.target: Pienso que ha sido interesante porque he visto el paisaje.
a2-05-04.english: I think it has been interesting because I have seen the landscape.
a2-05-04.canDo: I can give a simple opinion and a reason about a recent experience.

a2-05-05.title: Communicative Challenge: An Unexpected Day
a2-05-05.scenario: At dinner in Ninh Bình, Lauren asks you about the unexpected excursion. It rained, so you changed the route and saw a different landscape, and you thought it was fun.
a2-05-05.prompt: Tell Lauren why the excursion was unexpected, what you did as a result, and what you think of it.
cues: Say what you did as a result
a2-05-05.target: La excursión ha sido inesperada porque ha llovido. Hemos cambiado la ruta, por eso hemos visto otro paisaje. Pienso que ha sido divertido.
a2-05-05.english: The excursion has been unexpected because it has rained. We have changed the route, so we have seen another landscape. I think it has been fun.
a2-05-05.canDo: I can describe an unexpected excursion, including experiences, reasons, consequences and opinions.

a2-05-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Are You Back?
a2-05-consolidation.scenario: Daniela meets you at the hotel in Ninh Bình and asks why you have returned from the excursion and what you think of it. It has rained and you found it interesting.
a2-05-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela why you have returned and what you think of the excursion.
a2-05-consolidation.target: He vuelto porque ha llovido. Pienso que ha sido interesante.
a2-05-consolidation.english: I have returned because it has rained. I think it has been interesting.
a2-05-consolidation.canDo: I can explain why something has happened and what happened as a result.

a2-06-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Hotel?
a2-06-01.scenario: On the way back from Ninh Bình, Daniela asks you which of the two hotels was better value. The first hotel was cheaper.
a2-06-01.prompt: Tell Daniela that this hotel is cheaper than the other one.
cues: Say it costs less than the other
a2-06-01.target: Este hotel es más barato que el otro.
a2-06-01.english: This hotel is cheaper than the other one.
a2-06-01.canDo: I can compare two trips or places using más, menos and tan.

a2-06-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Villages and Cities
a2-06-02.scenario: Lauren asks you whether you find the villages of Ninh Bình or the big cities quieter. For you the villages are quieter.
a2-06-02.prompt: Tell Lauren that the villages are quieter than the cities.
a2-06-02.target: Los pueblos son más tranquilos que las ciudades.
a2-06-02.english: The villages are quieter than the cities.
a2-06-02.canDo: I can compare places and experiences using comparative adjectives with correct agreement.

a2-06-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Long Journey
a2-06-03.scenario: On the train to Hanoi, Kaylee asks you how this trip has been. It has been longer than your previous trip.
a2-06-03.prompt: Tell Kaylee that this trip has been longer than the previous one.
cues: Compare its length with the previous trip
a2-06-03.target: Este viaje ha sido más largo que el anterior.
a2-06-03.english: This trip has been longer than the previous one.
a2-06-03.canDo: I can compare recent experiences using comparative structures with the pretérito perfecto.

a2-06-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Class or Walk?
a2-06-04.scenario: Carlos asks you whether you prefer the cooking class or the walk. You prefer the class because it was more fun.
a2-06-04.prompt: Tell Carlos which you prefer and why, comparing the class with the walk.
cues: Say why it is more fun
a2-06-04.target: Prefiero la clase de cocina; es más divertida que el paseo.
a2-06-04.english: I prefer the cooking class; it is more fun than the walk.
a2-06-04.canDo: I can compare places and memories using comparative expressions with travel and opinion vocabulary.

a2-06-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Better Trip
a2-06-05.scenario: On the train back to Hanoi, Daniela asks you how this year's trip compares with last year's and which activity you liked best. You have travelled more this year, and the boat trip was more interesting than the excursion.
a2-06-05.prompt: Tell Daniela that this year you have travelled more than last year and that the boat trip has been more interesting than the excursion.
cues: Compare this year with last year
Compare the boat trip with the excursion
a2-06-05.target: Este año he viajado más que el año pasado. El paseo en barco ha sido más interesante que la excursión.
a2-06-05.english: This year I have travelled more than last year. The boat trip has been more interesting than the excursion.
a2-06-05.canDo: I can talk about recent trips, places and memories using the pretérito perfecto and comparisons.

a2-06-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Special Trips
a2-06-consolidation.scenario: On the train to Hanoi, Carlos asks you how this trip compares with the previous one. It has been just as special, but the return has been less comfortable than the trip.
a2-06-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that this trip has been as special as the previous one and that the return has been less comfortable than the trip.
cues: Say the two trips are equally special
Compare the return with the trip
a2-06-consolidation.target: Este viaje ha sido tan especial como el anterior. El regreso ha sido menos cómodo que el viaje.
a2-06-consolidation.english: This trip has been as special as the previous one. The return has been less comfortable than the trip.
a2-06-consolidation.canDo: I can compare recent trips, places and memories.

a2-07-01.title: Communicative Challenge: How Long in Hanoi?
a2-07-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Kaylee asks you how long you have been living in the city. You have lived there for three months.
a2-07-01.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you have lived in Hanoi for three months.
a2-07-01.target: Vivo en Hanói desde hace tres meses.
a2-07-01.english: I have lived in Hanoi for three months.
a2-07-01.canDo: I can say how long I have been doing something using desde hace.

a2-07-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Since When Do You Study?
a2-07-02.scenario: At the language exchange, Carlos asks you since when you have been studying Spanish. You started last year.
a2-07-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have studied Spanish since last year.
a2-07-02.target: Estudio español desde el año pasado.
a2-07-02.english: I have been studying Spanish since last year.
a2-07-02.canDo: I can say when an activity started using desde.

a2-07-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Since or For?
a2-07-03.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Daniela asks you since when you have lived there and how long you have studied Spanish. You came in January and you have studied Spanish for a year.
a2-07-03.prompt: Tell Daniela that you have lived here since January and that you have studied Spanish for a year.
cues: Say since when you live here
Say how long you have studied Spanish
a2-07-03.target: Vivo aquí desde enero y estudio español desde hace un año.
a2-07-03.english: I have lived here since January and I have studied Spanish for a year.
a2-07-03.canDo: I can choose desde or desde hace correctly when talking about duration.

a2-07-04.title: Communicative Challenge: An Old Friend
a2-07-04.scenario: At the language exchange, Lauren asks you how long you have known Daniela and since when you have practised Spanish together. You have known her for a year, and you started practising in January.
a2-07-04.prompt: Tell Lauren how long you have known Daniela and since when you have practised Spanish together.
cues: Say how long you have known Daniela
Say since when you practise together
a2-07-04.target: Conozco a Daniela desde hace un año. Practicamos español desde enero.
a2-07-04.english: I have known Daniela for a year. We have practised Spanish since January.
a2-07-04.canDo: I can talk about how long I have known people and studied languages.

a2-07-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Classmate
a2-07-05.scenario: At the language exchange, Lucía, the new classmate, asks you how long you have studied Spanish and whether you have travelled in Vietnam. You have studied Spanish since last year and you have already been to Ninh Bình.
a2-07-05.prompt: Tell Lucía that you have studied Spanish since last year and that you have already travelled to Ninh Bình.
cues: Say since when you have studied Spanish
Say where you have already travelled
a2-07-05.target: He estudiado español desde el año pasado. Ya he viajado a Ninh Bình.
a2-07-05.english: I have studied Spanish since last year. I have already travelled to Ninh Bình.
a2-07-05.canDo: I can talk about recent experiences and how long activities or relationships have continued.

a2-07-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Six Months in Vietnam
a2-07-consolidation.scenario: At the language exchange, Lucía asks you how long you have lived in Vietnam and since when you have known Carlos. You have lived there for six months, and you have known Carlos since January.
a2-07-consolidation.prompt: Tell Lucía how long you have lived in Vietnam and since when you have known Carlos.
cues: Say how long you have lived in Vietnam
Say since when you have known Carlos
a2-07-consolidation.target: Vivo en Vietnam desde hace seis meses y conozco a Carlos desde enero.
a2-07-consolidation.english: I have lived in Vietnam for six months and I have known Carlos since January.
a2-07-consolidation.canDo: I can use desde and desde hace to talk about duration.

a2-08-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Party on Saturday
a2-08-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi you want to invite Lauren to a party on Saturday.
a2-08-01.prompt: Invite Lauren to the party on Saturday.
cues: Ask if she wants to come
a2-08-01.target: ¿Quieres venir a la fiesta el sábado?
a2-08-01.english: Do you want to come to the party on Saturday?
a2-08-01.canDo: I can make a simple invitation and respond positively.

a2-08-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans for Saturday
a2-08-02.scenario: Daniela invites you to dinner on Saturday, but you have already made a plan.
a2-08-02.prompt: Tell Daniela that you are sorry and that you have already made a plan.
cues: Say what you have already done
a2-08-02.target: Lo siento, ya he hecho un plan.
a2-08-02.english: I'm sorry, I have already made a plan.
a2-08-02.canDo: I can say that I have already made plans when responding to an invitation.

a2-08-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Bought Yet
a2-08-03.scenario: Lucía invites you to cook together on Saturday. You want to go, but you have not bought the food yet.
a2-08-03.prompt: Tell Lucía that you want to come but that you have not bought the food yet.
cues: Say what you have not done yet
a2-08-03.target: Quiero ir, pero todavía no he comprado la comida.
a2-08-03.english: I want to go, but I have not bought the food yet.
a2-08-03.canDo: I can say that I have not done something yet in an invitation context.

a2-08-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Dish and Drink
a2-08-04.scenario: Lucía asks what you have prepared for her dinner. You have prepared a dish but you have not bought the drink.
a2-08-04.prompt: Tell Lucía that you have already prepared the dish but have not bought the drink yet.
cues: Say what you have already prepared
Say what you have not bought yet
a2-08-04.target: Ya he preparado el plato, pero todavía no he comprado la bebida.
a2-08-04.english: I have already prepared the dish, but I have not bought the drink yet.
a2-08-04.canDo: I can talk about what I have already prepared and what I have not prepared yet.

a2-08-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Dinner at Lucía's
a2-08-05.scenario: Lucía invites everyone to a special dinner in her apartment. You want to go, and you have already bought a drink.
a2-08-05.prompt: Tell Lucía that you want to come and that you have already bought the drink.
cues: Say what you have already done
a2-08-05.target: Sí, quiero ir. Ya he comprado la bebida.
a2-08-05.english: Yes, I want to go. I have already bought the drink.
a2-08-05.canDo: I can make and respond to invitations while talking about recent preparations.

a2-08-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Party with Kaylee
a2-08-consolidation.scenario: Kaylee invites you to a party on Saturday. You can go, but you have not cooked yet.
a2-08-consolidation.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you can go and that you have not cooked yet.
cues: Say what you have not done yet
a2-08-consolidation.target: Sí, puedo ir, pero todavía no he cocinado.
a2-08-consolidation.english: Yes, I can go, but I have not cooked yet.
a2-08-consolidation.canDo: I can make and respond to invitations using recent experiences.

a2-09-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Have You Seen the Beach?
a2-09-01.scenario: At the language exchange, Daniela talks about the beaches of Vietnam. You want to know whether she has ever visited a beach there.
a2-09-01.prompt: Ask Daniela whether she has ever visited the beach.
a2-09-01.english: Have you ever visited the beach?
a2-09-01.canDo: I can ask whether someone has ever had an experience using alguna vez.

a2-09-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Never by the Sea
a2-09-02.scenario: Lucía asks whether you have ever visited the little village by the sea. You have never been there.
a2-09-02.prompt: Tell Lucía that you have never visited the village.
cues: Say what you have never done
a2-09-02.english: I have never visited the village.
a2-09-02.canDo: I can say that I have never had an experience using nunca.

a2-09-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Port for the First Time
a2-09-03.scenario: On the way to the coast, you and Kaylee talk about ports. You want to know if she has ever been to one, and you have never been to a port yourself.
a2-09-03.prompt: Ask Kaylee whether she has ever been to a port, then say that you have never been to one.
cues: Say you have never been to a port
a2-09-03.target: ¿Has estado alguna vez en un puerto? Nunca he estado en un puerto.
a2-09-03.english: Have you ever been to a port? I have never been to a port.
a2-09-03.canDo: I can ask and answer experience questions with alguna vez and nunca.

a2-09-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Seafood by the Sea
a2-09-04.scenario: In a restaurant by the sea you ask Meg whether she has ever tried seafood, and you tell her that you have never taken an excursion to the sea.
a2-09-04.prompt: Ask Meg whether she has ever tried seafood, then say that you have never taken an excursion to the sea.
cues: Say what you have never done
a2-09-04.target: ¿Has probado alguna vez el marisco? Nunca he hecho una excursión al mar.
a2-09-04.english: Have you ever tried seafood? I have never taken an excursion to the sea.
a2-09-04.canDo: I can talk about experiences by the sea using familiar experience questions.

a2-09-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Souvenir from the Market
a2-09-05.scenario: At the market in the coastal village, you ask Meg whether she has ever bought a souvenir, and you tell her that you have bought one today.
a2-09-05.prompt: Ask Meg whether she has ever bought a souvenir, then say that you have bought one today.
cues: Say what you have bought today
a2-09-05.target: ¿Has comprado alguna vez un recuerdo? Hoy he comprado un recuerdo en el mercado.
a2-09-05.english: Have you ever bought a souvenir? Today I have bought a souvenir at the market.
a2-09-05.canDo: I can ask about and describe experiences during a trip to the beach.

a2-09-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Fish and Seafood
a2-09-consolidation.scenario: In a restaurant by the sea, Carlos asks you whether you have ever tried fish. You have never tried it, and you want to ask him about seafood.
a2-09-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have never tried fish, then ask him whether he has ever tried seafood.
cues: Say what you have never tried
a2-09-consolidation.target: No, nunca he probado el pescado. ¿Has probado tú alguna vez el marisco?
a2-09-consolidation.english: No, I have never tried fish. Have you ever tried seafood?
a2-09-consolidation.canDo: I can ask and answer questions about experiences.

a2-10-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Has Called?
a2-10-01.scenario: It is Sunday afternoon in Carlos and Meg's flat in Hanoi. Carlos asks whether your family has been in touch today. Your mother has called, and your father has spoken with your sister.
a2-10-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that your mother has called today and that your father has spoken with your sister.
cues: Say who your father has spoken with
a2-10-01.target: Mi madre ha llamado hoy. Mi padre ha hablado con mi hermana.
a2-10-01.english: My mother has called today. My father has spoken with my sister.
a2-10-01.canDo: I can talk about what family members have done recently.

a2-10-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Already or Not Yet
a2-10-02.scenario: Meg asks you about the messages from your family. You have already answered the message, but you have not sent the photos yet.
a2-10-02.prompt: Tell Meg that you have already answered the message and that you have not sent the photos yet.
cues: Say what you have already done with the message
Say what you have not done yet with the photos
a2-10-02.target: Ya he contestado el mensaje. Todavía no he enviado las fotos.
a2-10-02.english: I have already answered the message. I have not sent the photos yet.
a2-10-02.canDo: I can say what has already happened and what has not happened yet.

a2-10-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Did You Call?
a2-10-03.scenario: Carlos sees you with your phone and asks why you have called your mother. You have called her because you have received some news.
a2-10-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have called your mother because you have received some news.
a2-10-03.target: He llamado a mi madre porque he recibido una noticia.
a2-10-03.english: I have called my mother because I have received some news.
a2-10-03.canDo: I can give simple reasons for recent actions using porque.

a2-10-04.title: Communicative Challenge: News from Home
a2-10-04.scenario: Kaylee asks whether you have written to your father and called your mother. You have already written to your father because you have some news, but you have not called your mother yet because you are busy.
a2-10-04.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you have already written to your father because you have news, and that you have not called your mother yet because you are busy.
cues: Say what you have already done, and why
Say what you have not done yet, and why
a2-10-04.target: Ya he escrito a mi padre porque tengo una noticia. Todavía no he llamado a mi madre porque estoy ocupado.
a2-10-04.english: I have already written to my father because I have some news. I have not called my mother yet because I am busy.
a2-10-04.canDo: I can combine ya, todavía and porque when talking about communication.

a2-10-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Call from Home
a2-10-05.scenario: After the Sunday calls, Daniela asks about your call from home. Your mother has already called and the conversation was calm, but you have not spoken with your father yet.
a2-10-05.prompt: Tell Daniela that your mother has already called and that you have had a calm conversation, and that you have not spoken with your father yet.
cues: Say your mother has already called and how the conversation was
Say who you have not spoken with yet
a2-10-05.target: Mi madre ya ha llamado y hemos tenido una conversación tranquila. Todavía no he hablado con mi padre.
a2-10-05.english: My mother has already called and we have had a calm conversation. I have not spoken with my father yet.
a2-10-05.canDo: I can talk about a recent call from home, saying what has happened, what has not happened yet and why.

a2-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Sunday Calls
a2-10-consolidation.scenario: On Sunday in the flat, Carlos asks whether you have called your family and answered Meg's message. You have called your family, but you have not answered the message yet because you are busy.
a2-10-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have already called your family and that you have not answered the message yet because you are busy.
cues: Say what you have already done
Say what you have not done yet, and why
a2-10-consolidation.target: Ya he llamado a mi familia. Todavía no he contestado el mensaje porque estoy ocupado.
a2-10-consolidation.english: I have already called my family. I have not answered the message yet because I am busy.
a2-10-consolidation.canDo: I can use the main pretérito perfecto structures from Units 1–10.

a2-11-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Last Weekend
a2-11-01.scenario: On Monday at the language exchange in Hanoi, Lucía asks what you did at the festival last weekend. You danced and you celebrated a tradition with your friends.
a2-11-01.prompt: Tell Lucía that you danced at the festival and that you celebrated a tradition with your friends.
cues: Say what you did at the festival
Say what you celebrated and with whom
a2-11-01.target: Bailé en el festival y celebré una tradición con mis amigos.
a2-11-01.english: I danced at the festival and I celebrated a tradition with my friends.
a2-11-01.canDo: I can describe completed past events using regular pretérito indefinido forms.

a2-11-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Day
a2-11-02.scenario: After the festival in Hanoi, Meg asks how your day was. You went to the festival, you had a good day and you took many photographs.
a2-11-02.prompt: Tell Meg that you went to the festival, that you had a good day and that you took many photographs.
cues: Say what you did with the camera
a2-11-02.target: Fui al festival y tuve un buen día. Hice muchas fotografías.
a2-11-02.english: I went to the festival and I had a good day. I took many photographs.
a2-11-02.canDo: I can describe what happened at a festival using common irregular pretérito indefinido forms.

a2-11-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Did You Do?
a2-11-03.scenario: You meet Kaylee in Hanoi after the festival. You want to know what she did yesterday and what she bought.
a2-11-03.prompt: Ask Kaylee what she did yesterday and what she bought.
a2-11-03.english: What did you do yesterday? What did you buy?
a2-11-03.canDo: I can ask and answer questions about completed past events.

a2-11-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Day in Order
a2-11-04.scenario: Lucía asks you to tell her your day at the festival in order. First you visited the festival, afterwards you bought a fan, and in the afternoon you went to the concert.
a2-11-04.prompt: Tell Lucía your day in order: first you visited the festival, afterwards you bought a fan, and in the afternoon you went to the concert.
cues: Say what you did in the afternoon
a2-11-04.target: Primero visité el festival. Después compré un abanico. Por la tarde fui al concierto.
a2-11-04.english: First I visited the festival. Afterwards I bought a fan. In the afternoon I went to the concert.
a2-11-04.canDo: I can sequence completed events when recounting a day at a festival.

a2-11-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Festival in the City
a2-11-05.scenario: Back in the flat, Carlos asks you to recount the festival in the city. You went to the festival, you tried a traditional sweet, you bought a fan and in the afternoon you were at a concert.
a2-11-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened at the festival: where you went, what you tried and bought, and where you were in the afternoon.
cues: Say what you tried and what you bought
Say where you were in the afternoon
a2-11-05.target: Primero fui al festival. Probé un dulce tradicional y compré un abanico. Por la tarde estuve en un concierto.
a2-11-05.english: First I went to the festival. I tried a traditional sweet and I bought a fan. In the afternoon I was at a concert.
a2-11-05.canDo: I can recount what happened during a recent festival using regular and irregular pretérito indefinido.

a2-11-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Festival Day
a2-11-consolidation.scenario: On Sunday Daniela asks about your day at the festival in Hanoi with your friends. You went with your friends, you danced first and afterwards you took many photographs.
a2-11-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela that you went to the festival with your friends, that you danced first and that afterwards you took many photographs.
cues: Say where you went and with whom
a2-11-consolidation.target: Fui al festival con mis amigos. Primero bailé y después hice muchas fotografías.
a2-11-consolidation.english: I went to the festival with my friends. First I danced and afterwards I took many photographs.
a2-11-consolidation.canDo: I can use the pretérito indefinido to recount a day at the festival.

a2-12-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Gift and Card
a2-12-01.scenario: At Lucía's surprise, Meg asks about the gift and the card. You bought the gift and you received the card.
a2-12-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you bought the gift and that you received the card, using a pronoun for each.
cues: Say you bought the gift (use a pronoun)
Say you received the card (use a pronoun)
a2-12-01.english: I bought it. I received it.
a2-12-01.canDo: I can say what I bought or received and refer to the object with a direct object pronoun.

a2-12-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Flower and Cards
a2-12-02.scenario: Before the surprise for Lucía, Kaylee asks about the flower and the cards. You bought the flower and you prepared the cards.
a2-12-02.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you bought the flower and that you prepared the cards, using a pronoun for each.
cues: Say you bought the flower (use a pronoun)
Say you prepared the cards (use a pronoun)
a2-12-02.english: I bought it. I prepared them.
a2-12-02.canDo: I can place the direct object pronoun before the verb and choose lo, la, los or las.

a2-12-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Did You Buy Them?
a2-12-03.scenario: Lauren is getting ready for Lucía's surprise. You want to know whether she bought the flowers and whether she received the card.
a2-12-03.prompt: Ask Lauren whether she bought the flowers and whether she received the card.
cues: Ask if she bought the flowers
Ask if she received the card
a2-12-03.english: Did you buy the flowers? Did you receive the card?
a2-12-03.canDo: I can ask and answer questions about what people bought or received.

a2-12-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Part in the Surprise
a2-12-04.scenario: Meg asks about your part in the surprise for Lucía. You chose the gift and bought it, and you bought the flowers and wrapped them.
a2-12-04.prompt: Tell Meg that you chose the gift and bought it, and that you bought the flowers and wrapped them.
cues: Say what you chose and bought, with a pronoun
Say what you bought and wrapped, with a pronoun
a2-12-04.target: Elegí el regalo y lo compré. Compré las flores y las envolví.
a2-12-04.english: I chose the gift and bought it. I bought the flowers and wrapped them.
a2-12-04.canDo: I can talk about gifts and surprises using direct object pronouns with common past-tense verbs.

a2-12-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Surprise for Lucía
a2-12-05.scenario: After the surprise at Lucía's apartment, Carlos asks what your group did. You prepared the surprise and took it to Lucía, and Lucía received the flowers and kept them.
a2-12-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that you prepared the surprise and took it to Lucía, and that Lucía received the flowers and kept them.
cues: Say what you prepared and did with it
Say what Lucía received and did with it
a2-12-05.target: Preparamos la sorpresa y la llevamos a Lucía. Lucía recibió las flores y las guardó.
a2-12-05.english: We prepared the surprise and took it to Lucía. Lucía received the flowers and kept them.
a2-12-05.canDo: I can recount a surprise using the pretérito indefinido and direct object pronouns.

a2-12-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Gifts and Cards
a2-12-consolidation.scenario: Lauren asks about the gifts and the cards for Lucía. You bought the gifts and wrapped them, and you received the cards and took them.
a2-12-consolidation.prompt: Tell Lauren that you bought the gifts and wrapped them, and that you received the cards and took them.
cues: Say what you bought and wrapped, with a pronoun
Say what you received and kept, with a pronoun
a2-12-consolidation.target: Compré los regalos y los envolví. Recibí las tarjetas y las llevé.
a2-12-consolidation.english: I bought the gifts and wrapped them. I received the cards and took them.
a2-12-consolidation.canDo: I can use direct object pronouns with the pretérito indefinido.

a2-13-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Gloves
a2-13-01.scenario: After the volunteer day in the park in Hanoi, Lucía is writing a message to her family and asks you when the group received the gloves. You received them when you arrived at the park.
a2-13-01.prompt: Tell Lucía that you received the gloves when you arrived at the park.
a2-13-01.target: Recibimos los guantes cuando llegamos al parque.
a2-13-01.english: We received the gloves when we arrived at the park.
a2-13-01.canDo: I can say when a completed past action happened using cuando and the pretérito indefinido.

a2-13-02.title: Communicative Challenge: While We Worked
a2-13-02.scenario: Daniela is writing captions for the photos of the volunteer day in the park in Hanoi and asks what you did while you collected rubbish. You spoke with the volunteers.
a2-13-02.prompt: Tell Daniela that you spoke with the volunteers while you collected rubbish.
cues: Say what else you did at the same time
a2-13-02.target: Mientras recogimos basura, hablamos con los voluntarios.
a2-13-02.english: While we collected rubbish, we spoke with the volunteers.
a2-13-02.canDo: I can connect simultaneous past actions using mientras.

a2-13-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Cuando or Mientras
a2-13-03.scenario: Lucía arrived late to the park in Hanoi and asks what happened before she came. When you arrived at the neighbourhood you cleaned the park, and you spoke with other people while you worked.
a2-13-03.prompt: Tell Lucía what you did when you arrived and what you did while you worked.
cues: Say what you did when you arrived
Say what you did while you worked
a2-13-03.target: Cuando llegamos al barrio, limpiamos el parque. Mientras trabajamos, hablamos con otras personas.
a2-13-03.english: When we arrived at the neighbourhood, we cleaned the park. While we worked, we spoke with other people.
a2-13-03.canDo: I can choose cuando or mientras when describing past events.

a2-13-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Day of Volunteering
a2-13-04.scenario: Carlos is making a photo album of the volunteer day at the park in Hanoi and asks you to tell the day in order. You received the gloves when you arrived, you collected rubbish while you worked, and afterwards you cleaned the park.
a2-13-04.prompt: Tell Carlos about the day in order: what happened when you arrived, while you worked, and afterwards.
cues: Say what you received when you arrived
Say what you did while you worked
a2-13-04.target: Cuando llegamos, recibimos los guantes. Mientras trabajamos, recogimos basura. Después limpiamos el parque.
a2-13-04.english: When we arrived, we received the gloves. While we worked, we collected rubbish. Afterwards we cleaned the park.
a2-13-04.canDo: I can connect and sequence events during a day of volunteering.

a2-13-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Volunteer Day
a2-13-05.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Lucía wants to write about the volunteer day and asks you to tell the story of the day. You received the gloves when you arrived, you planted flowers while you worked, and you went home when the activity ended.
a2-13-05.prompt: Tell Lucía the story of the volunteer day with cuando and mientras.
cues: Say what happened when you arrived
Say what you did while you worked
Say what you did when the activity ended
a2-13-05.target: Cuando llegamos, recibimos los guantes. Mientras trabajamos, plantamos flores. Cuando terminó la actividad, volvimos a casa.
a2-13-05.english: When we arrived, we received the gloves. While we worked, we planted flowers. When the activity ended, we went home.
a2-13-05.canDo: I can recount a day as volunteers using cuando, mientras and the pretérito indefinido.

a2-13-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Activity
a2-13-consolidation.scenario: Meg is writing a message for the language exchange group chat about the volunteer day at the park in Hanoi and asks what you did. The activity ended and you went home, and while you collected rubbish you spoke with other people.
a2-13-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you did when the activity ended and what you did while you collected rubbish.
cues: Say what you did when the activity ended
Say what you did while you collected rubbish
a2-13-consolidation.target: Cuando terminó la actividad, volvimos a casa. Mientras recogimos basura, hablamos con otras personas.
a2-13-consolidation.english: When the activity ended, we went home. While we collected rubbish, we spoke with other people.
a2-13-consolidation.canDo: I can use cuando and mientras with the pretérito indefinido.

a2-14-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Questions for the Craftsperson
a2-14-01.scenario: Lucía has brought the group to a ceramics workshop in Hanoi to interview a friend of hers who is a craftsperson. She asks you to start with two questions about his past: where he worked and when he arrived.
a2-14-01.prompt: Ask the craftsperson where he worked and when he arrived.
a2-14-01.english: Where did you work? When did you arrive?
a2-14-01.canDo: I can ask direct questions about completed past events using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-14-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Lucía Asked
a2-14-02.scenario: After the visit to the ceramics workshop in Hanoi, Carlos's sister Ana calls you and asks what Lucía wanted to know. Lucía asked where the craftsperson worked and wanted to know how the story began.
a2-14-02.prompt: Tell Ana that Lucía asked where the craftsperson worked and that she wanted to know how the story began.
cues: Report the question about the place
Report the question about how it began
a2-14-02.target: Lucía preguntó dónde trabajó el artesano y quiso saber cómo empezó la historia.
a2-14-02.english: Lucía asked where the craftsperson worked and wanted to know how the story began.
a2-14-02.canDo: I can report simple questions using qué, dónde, cuándo and cómo.

a2-14-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Craftsperson's Questions
a2-14-03.scenario: In the ceramics workshop in Hanoi, Meg was looking at the bowls and did not hear the craftsperson's questions. She asks you what he wanted to know. He asked who came to the workshop and which one she chose.
a2-14-03.prompt: Tell Meg that he asked who came and that he wanted to know which one she chose.
cues: Report the question about the people
Report the question about her choice
a2-14-03.target: Preguntó quién vino y quiso saber cuál elegiste.
a2-14-03.english: He asked who came and wanted to know which one you chose.
a2-14-03.canDo: I can report questions about people and things using quién, qué and cuál.

a2-14-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Question
a2-14-04.scenario: At the ceramics workshop in Hanoi you ask the craftsperson how the craft began. Afterwards Meg, who waited outside, asks what you asked him.
a2-14-04.prompt: Ask the craftsperson how the craft began, then tell Meg what you asked.
a2-14-04.target: ¿Cómo empezó el oficio? Pregunté cómo empezó el oficio.
a2-14-04.english: How did the craft begin? I asked how the craft began.
a2-14-04.canDo: I can ask and report simple questions about an interview and past events.

a2-14-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Interview
a2-14-05.scenario: Carlos's sister Ana calls and asks about the interview at the ceramics workshop in Hanoi. Carlos asked when the craftsperson began, and the craftsperson explained how the craft began.
a2-14-05.prompt: Tell Ana what Carlos asked and what the craftsperson explained.
a2-14-05.target: Carlos preguntó cuándo empezó. El artesano explicó cómo empezó el oficio.
a2-14-05.english: Carlos asked when he began. The craftsperson explained how the craft began.
a2-14-05.canDo: I can recount an interesting interview and report the questions people asked.

a2-14-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened?
a2-14-consolidation.scenario: You arrived late to the visit at the ceramics workshop in Hanoi. You ask Daniela what happened, and then you tell Lucía what Daniela asked you.
a2-14-consolidation.prompt: Ask Daniela what happened, then tell Lucía that Daniela asked when you arrived.
a2-14-consolidation.english: What happened? Daniela asked when I arrived.
a2-14-consolidation.canDo: I can ask and report simple questions about past events.

a2-15-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Is Lucía Going Back?
a2-15-01.scenario: At the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Lucía has told her friends that she has to go back to Spain. Carlos's sister Ana calls you and asks why Lucía decided to go back. Lucía received some news.
a2-15-01.prompt: Tell Ana that Lucía decided to go back to Spain because she received some news.
a2-15-01.target: Lucía decidió volver a España porque recibió una noticia.
a2-15-01.english: Lucía decided to go back to Spain because she received some news.
a2-15-01.canDo: I can explain why a completed past event happened using porque and the pretérito indefinido.

a2-15-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The News
a2-15-02.scenario: The evening after the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Carlos's sister Ana calls you and asks what happened to Lucía. Lucía received some news from Spain and so she decided to go back.
a2-15-02.prompt: Tell Ana that Lucía received some news and that is why she decided to go back to Spain.
cues: Say the result, with por eso
a2-15-02.target: Lucía recibió una noticia, por eso decidió volver a España.
a2-15-02.english: Lucía received some news, so she decided to go back to Spain.
a2-15-02.canDo: I can describe consequences of completed past events using por eso.

a2-15-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Cause and Consequence
a2-15-03.scenario: Back in the apartment after the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Meg asks you why everybody was sad. Lucía received some news and decided to go back, and the whole group was sad because they understood the situation.
a2-15-03.prompt: Tell Meg what Lucía's news caused and why everybody was sad.
cues: Say what happened to Lucía and the result
a2-15-03.target: Lucía recibió una noticia, por eso decidió volver. Todos estuvimos tristes porque entendimos la situación.
a2-15-03.english: Lucía received some news, so she decided to go back. We were all sad because we understood the situation.
a2-15-03.canDo: I can connect causes and consequences using porque and por eso.

a2-15-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How I Felt
a2-15-04.scenario: At the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Carlos's sister Ana calls you and asks how you felt about Lucía's news. You smiled because you remembered the trip, and you cried because you understood the situation.
a2-15-04.prompt: Tell Ana that you smiled because you remembered the trip, and that you understood the situation, so you cried.
cues: Say what you understood and the result
a2-15-04.target: Sonreí porque recordé el viaje. Entendí la situación, por eso lloré.
a2-15-04.english: I smiled because I remembered the trip. I understood the situation, so I cried.
a2-15-04.canDo: I can explain the causes and consequences of a goodbye using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-15-05.title: Communicative Challenge: An Unexpected Goodbye
a2-15-05.scenario: The week after the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Carlos's sister Ana calls and asks you to tell her the story. Lucía received some news and decided to go back to Spain; you smiled because you remembered the trip, and you cried because you understood the situation.
a2-15-05.prompt: Tell Ana the story: what Lucía's news led to, and how and why you felt.
cues: Say what Lucía received and decided
a2-15-05.target: Lucía recibió una noticia, por eso decidió volver a España. Sonreí porque recordé el viaje. Lloré porque entendí la situación.
a2-15-05.english: Lucía received some news, so she decided to go back to Spain. I smiled because I remembered the trip. I cried because I understood the situation.
a2-15-05.canDo: I can recount an unexpected goodbye and explain its causes, consequences and emotions.

a2-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Because and So
a2-15-consolidation.scenario: Carlos's sister Ana calls you after the picnic in the park in Hanoi. Lucía received some news and decided to go back to Spain; you were sad, so you wrote Lucía a message.
a2-15-consolidation.prompt: Tell Ana why Lucía decided to go back, and that you were sad, so you wrote Lucía a message.
cues: Say why Lucía decided to go back
Say what you did because you were sad
a2-15-consolidation.target: Lucía decidió volver porque recibió una noticia. Estuve triste, por eso escribí un mensaje.
a2-15-consolidation.english: Lucía decided to go back because she received some news. I was sad, so I wrote a message.
a2-15-consolidation.canDo: I can use porque and por eso with the pretérito indefinido.

a2-16-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Tomorrow's Letter
a2-16-01.scenario: At Carlos and Meg's flat in Hanoi, Meg asks what you are going to do tomorrow. You are going to write a letter.
a2-16-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you are going to write a letter tomorrow.
cues: Say what you are going to do
a2-16-01.target: Mañana voy a escribir una carta.
a2-16-01.english: Tomorrow I am going to write a letter.
a2-16-01.canDo: I can say what I am going to do using ir a + infinitive.

a2-16-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Yesterday and Last Year
a2-16-02.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Lucía asks what you did yesterday and when you finished your trip. You wrote a letter yesterday and finished the trip last year.
a2-16-02.prompt: Tell Lucía that you wrote a letter yesterday and that you finished the trip last year.
cues: Say when you finished the trip
a2-16-02.target: Ayer escribí una carta. Terminé el viaje el año pasado.
a2-16-02.english: Yesterday I wrote a letter. I finished the trip last year.
a2-16-02.canDo: I can use the pretérito indefinido to say what happened.

a2-16-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Past and Next
a2-16-03.scenario: At the language exchange, Daniela asks what happened and what you are going to do now. You wrote a letter and you are going to keep it.
a2-16-03.prompt: Tell Daniela that you wrote a letter and that you are going to keep it.
cues: Say what you are going to do with it
a2-16-03.target: Escribí una carta y voy a guardarla.
a2-16-03.english: I wrote a letter and I am going to keep it.
a2-16-03.canDo: I can contrast what happened with what you are going to do next.

a2-16-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Goals for Next Year
a2-16-04.scenario: At Carlos and Meg's flat, Kaylee asks about your goals for next year. You are going to learn Spanish and travel.
a2-16-04.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you are going to learn Spanish and travel next year.
cues: Say what you are going to learn
Say what else you are going to do next year
a2-16-04.target: El próximo año voy a aprender español y a viajar.
a2-16-04.english: Next year I am going to learn Spanish and travel.
a2-16-04.canDo: I can talk about my future plans and goals using ir a + infinitive.

a2-16-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Letter Box
a2-16-05.scenario: At Carlos and Meg's flat, Meg asks what you did with your letter and what you are going to do with it. You wrote it, put it in the box and you are going to open it next year.
a2-16-05.prompt: Tell Meg that you wrote a letter and kept it in the box, and that you are going to open it next year.
cues: Say what you wrote and where you kept it
Say what you are going to do next year
a2-16-05.target: Escribí una carta y la guardé en la caja. Voy a abrirla el próximo año.
a2-16-05.english: I wrote a letter and kept it in the box. I am going to open it next year.
a2-16-05.canDo: I can recount past events and describe future plans in a short narrative.

a2-16-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans and Past Events
a2-16-consolidation.scenario: At the language exchange, Lauren asks what you did yesterday and what you are going to do next year. You wrote a letter yesterday and next year you are going to travel.
a2-16-consolidation.prompt: Tell Lauren that you wrote a letter yesterday and that you are going to travel next year.
cues: Say what you are going to do next year
a2-16-consolidation.target: Ayer escribí una carta. El próximo año voy a viajar.
a2-16-consolidation.english: Yesterday I wrote a letter. Next year I am going to travel.
a2-16-consolidation.canDo: I can use ir a + infinitive and the pretérito indefinido to talk about plans and past events.

a2-17-01.title: Communicative Challenge: This Year in Class
a2-17-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Meg asks what you have done this year. You have learned a lot and you have met new classmates.
a2-17-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you have learned a lot this year and that you have met new classmates.
a2-17-01.target: Este año he aprendido mucho. He conocido a nuevos compañeros.
a2-17-01.english: This year I have learned a lot. I have met new classmates.
a2-17-01.canDo: I can talk about recent experiences and life events using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-17-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened Yesterday
a2-17-02.scenario: At the language exchange, Carlos asks what happened yesterday. The class finished and you remembered the first lesson.
a2-17-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that the class finished yesterday and that you remembered the first lesson.
cues: Say what happened to the class
a2-17-02.target: La clase terminó ayer. Recordé la primera lección.
a2-17-02.english: The class finished yesterday. I remembered the first lesson.
a2-17-02.canDo: I can recount completed past events using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-17-03.title: Communicative Challenge: This Year and Last Year
a2-17-03.scenario: At the language exchange, Daniela asks about your progress. This year you have learned a lot, and last year you changed course.
a2-17-03.prompt: Tell Daniela that you have learned a lot this year and that you changed course last year.
cues: Say what you have done this year
Say what you did last year
a2-17-03.target: Este año he aprendido mucho. El año pasado cambié de curso.
a2-17-03.english: This year I have learned a lot. Last year I changed course.
a2-17-03.canDo: I can choose between the pretérito perfecto and indefinido when talking about past events.

a2-17-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking Back
a2-17-04.scenario: At the language exchange, Lucía asks how your Spanish is going. This year you have improved a lot, and last year you continued the course.
a2-17-04.prompt: Tell Lucía that you have improved a lot this year and that you continued the course last year.
cues: Say how you have improved this year
Say what you did last year
a2-17-04.target: Este año he mejorado mucho. El año pasado continué el curso.
a2-17-04.english: This year I have improved a lot. Last year I continued the course.
a2-17-04.canDo: I can choose the appropriate past tense in familiar A2 contexts.

a2-17-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Last Class
a2-17-05.scenario: After the last class at the language exchange, Meg asks you how it went. The teacher prepared some activities and everyone had a lot of fun.
a2-17-05.prompt: Tell Meg that the teacher prepared some activities and that everyone had a lot of fun.
a2-17-05.target: El profesor preparó unas actividades y todos se divirtieron mucho.
a2-17-05.english: The teacher prepared some activities and everyone had a lot of fun.
a2-17-05.canDo: I can talk about experiences, relationships and completed events in a final A2 narrative.

a2-17-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Year of Spanish
a2-17-consolidation.scenario: At the language exchange, Kaylee asks about your year and about yesterday. This year you have improved a lot and yesterday you finished the course.
a2-17-consolidation.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you have improved a lot this year and that you finished the course yesterday.
cues: Say what you have done this year
a2-17-consolidation.target: Este año he mejorado mucho y ayer terminé el curso.
a2-17-consolidation.english: This year I have improved a lot and yesterday I finished the course.
a2-17-consolidation.canDo: I can choose between the pretérito perfecto and indefinido in familiar A2 contexts.

a2-18-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting Ready
a2-18-01.scenario: The day before Lucía's flight from Hanoi, Meg asks what you are going to do. You are going to prepare your suitcase and leave for the airport tomorrow.
a2-18-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you are going to prepare your suitcase and that you are going to leave for the airport tomorrow.
cues: Say what you are going to prepare
Say where you are going to leave for, and when
a2-18-01.target: Voy a preparar la maleta. Mañana voy a salir al aeropuerto.
a2-18-01.english: I am going to prepare the suitcase. Tomorrow I am going to leave for the airport.
a2-18-01.canDo: I can talk about immediate travel plans using ir a + infinitive.

a2-18-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Arriving at the Airport
a2-18-02.scenario: Carlos asks what happened when you went to the airport in Hanoi. You arrived early and the plane took off at eight.
a2-18-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you arrived at the airport early and that the plane took off at eight.
a2-18-02.target: Llegué al aeropuerto temprano. El avión despegó a las ocho.
a2-18-02.english: I arrived at the airport early. The plane took off at eight.
a2-18-02.canDo: I can recount completed travel events using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-18-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Year of Trips
a2-18-03.scenario: At the language exchange, Daniela asks about your travels. You have travelled a lot this year and you have visited several cities.
a2-18-03.prompt: Tell Daniela that you have travelled a lot this year and that you have visited several cities.
cues: Say how much you have travelled
a2-18-03.target: He viajado mucho este año. He visitado varias ciudades.
a2-18-03.english: I have travelled a lot this year. I have visited several cities.
a2-18-03.canDo: I can talk about recent travel experiences using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-18-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Before and After
a2-18-04.scenario: At the flat, Kaylee asks what you did before the trip and after arriving. Before leaving you prepared your suitcase and after arriving you visited the city.
a2-18-04.prompt: Tell Kaylee that before leaving you prepared your suitcase and that after arriving you visited the city.
cues: Say what you did before leaving
Say what you did after arriving
a2-18-04.target: Antes de salir, preparé la maleta. Después de llegar, visité la ciudad.
a2-18-04.english: Before leaving, I prepared the suitcase. After arriving, I visited the city.
a2-18-04.canDo: I can sequence and connect travel events using familiar A2 structures.

a2-18-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Saying Goodbye to Lucía
a2-18-05.scenario: At the airport in Hanoi, Meg asks what you did today and what Lucía is going to do. You went to the airport to say goodbye to Lucía, and she is going to return to Spain.
a2-18-05.prompt: Tell Meg that you went to the airport to say goodbye to Lucía and that she is going to return to Spain.
cues: Say what you did and why
Say what Lucía is going to do
a2-18-05.target: Hoy he ido al aeropuerto para despedirme de Lucía. Va a volver a España.
a2-18-05.english: Today I have been to the airport to say goodbye to Lucía. She is going to go back to Spain.
a2-18-05.canDo: I can describe travel, memories and departure in an integrated A2 narrative.

a2-18-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans, Trip and Year
a2-18-consolidation.scenario: At the airport, Lauren asks about your trip. You are going to prepare your suitcase, you arrived at the airport early yesterday and you have travelled a lot this year.
a2-18-consolidation.prompt: Tell Lauren that you are going to prepare your suitcase, that you arrived at the airport early yesterday and that you have travelled a lot this year.
cues: Say what you are going to prepare
Say what you have done this year
a2-18-consolidation.target: Voy a preparar la maleta. Ayer llegué al aeropuerto temprano. Este año he viajado mucho.
a2-18-consolidation.english: I am going to prepare the suitcase. Yesterday I arrived at the airport early. This year I have travelled a lot.
a2-18-consolidation.canDo: I can use familiar A2 structures to talk about travel, memories and departure.

a2-19-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Next Year
a2-19-01.scenario: At the café in Hanoi, Meg asks you about your plans for next year. You will travel and work.
a2-19-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you will do next year.
a2-19-01.target: Viajaré el próximo año. Trabajaré también.
a2-19-01.english: I will travel next year. I will work too.
a2-19-01.canDo: I can make simple statements about the future using regular futuro simple forms.

a2-19-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Will You Do?
a2-19-02.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, you ask Carlos about tomorrow and about where he will live next year.
a2-19-02.prompt: Ask Carlos what he will do tomorrow and where he will live next year.
cues: Ask what he will do tomorrow
Ask where he will live next year
a2-19-02.target: ¿Qué harás mañana? ¿Dónde vivirás el próximo año?
a2-19-02.english: What will you do tomorrow? Where will you live next year?
a2-19-02.canDo: I can ask and answer questions about future actions and plans.

a2-19-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Predictions
a2-19-03.scenario: At the café, Daniela wonders about the future of the language exchange in Hanoi. You give your prediction.
a2-19-03.prompt: Tell Daniela what you think will happen soon.
cues: Say it will probably happen soon
a2-19-03.target: Creo que cambiará mucho. Probablemente sucederá pronto.
a2-19-03.english: I think it will change a lot. It will probably happen soon.
a2-19-03.canDo: I can talk about predictions and expectations using the futuro simple.

a2-19-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Goals
a2-19-04.scenario: At the café, Kaylee asks about your goals. You want to save money and to achieve your goals.
cues: Say you will achieve your goals
a2-19-04.target: Ahorraré dinero para viajar. Lograré mis objetivos.
a2-19-04.english: I will save money to travel. I will achieve my goals.
a2-19-04.canDo: I can talk about future plans, intentions and personal goals using the futuro simple.

a2-19-05.title: Communicative Challenge: New Paths
a2-19-05.scenario: After Lucía's farewell, the friends meet at their favourite café in Hanoi. Lauren asks what you will do now.
a2-19-05.prompt: Tell Lauren what you will do and say that you will always be friends.
cues: Say you will always be friends
a2-19-05.target: Viajaré por el sur de Vietnam. Siempre seremos amigos.
a2-19-05.english: I will travel through the south of Vietnam. We will always be friends.
a2-19-05.canDo: I can talk about what I and my friends will do in the future.

a2-19-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans and Predictions
a2-19-consolidation.scenario: At the café in Hanoi, Meg asks about your plans and what you think will happen.
a2-19-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg your plan for tomorrow and your prediction.
cues: Say what you will do tomorrow
a2-19-consolidation.english: I will work tomorrow. It will probably happen soon.
a2-19-consolidation.canDo: I can use the futuro simple to talk about plans, predictions and goals.

a2-20-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What We Have Learnt
a2-20-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Meg asks what you have done this year in the course.
a2-20-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you have learnt and shared this year.
cues: Say you have learnt a lot
a2-20-01.target: Hemos aprendido mucho este año. Hemos compartido muchos recuerdos.
a2-20-01.english: We have learnt a lot this year. We have shared many memories.
a2-20-01.canDo: I can talk about experiences and recent actions using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-20-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened
a2-20-02.scenario: Weeks after the goodbye, Carlos asks what happened with Daniela and Lauren.
a2-20-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what Daniela and Lauren did.
cues: Say where Daniela went back to
a2-20-02.target: Daniela regresó a Chile. Lauren encontró un nuevo trabajo.
a2-20-02.english: Daniela returned to Chile. Lauren found a new job.
a2-20-02.canDo: I can recount completed events and simple narratives using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-20-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Are You Going to Do?
a2-20-03.scenario: At the café, Meg asks what you are going to do after the course.
a2-20-03.prompt: Tell Meg what you are going to do next.
cues: Say you are going to begin a new chapter
Say you are going to return soon
a2-20-03.target: Voy a empezar un nuevo capítulo. Voy a volver pronto.
a2-20-03.english: I am going to begin a new chapter. I am going to return soon.
a2-20-03.canDo: I can talk about immediate future plans using ir a + infinitive.

a2-20-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Will Happen
